dang pa/par skrun gsal bshad/༄༅༅/ /rang cag bod gangs can pa rnams kyi dpral ba'i mig dang / khog pa'i snying / 'di phyi gnas skabs thams cad kyi 7skyabs gnas re lta sa zhu yul 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen wa mchodag las gzhan du gnyis pa zhig med cing /deng btsan byol ba'i gnas stangs nyams su myong ba'i skabs 'dir gang gi mdzad 'phrin 'dzam gling shar nub yongs la khyab nas zhi bde'i ded dpon chen por mnga' gsol ba gang gi rlabs chen mdzad 'phrin gyi gzi brjid yin par ma zad/ gangs can pa'i bden mtha' myur du gsal ba'i dan rtags kyang yin/'on kyang legs bshad las/nyi ma'i 'od zer 'char ba na//'byung po'i bya rnams long bar 'gyur//

gnyis pa/zhes gre/sungs pa ltar/ pha rol rgya dmar phyogs dang /de'i sug zas la brten nas mi tshe 'phyid thabs byed mkhan log smon can nyung shas nas 7gong sa mchog la mtshan smad skur 'debs kyi yig cha nag po snga rjes bton pa kun shes dang / gzhung dmangs phyogs gang sa nas lan 'debs gnad du khel ba gnang bar brten kho pa tsho bo gas med kher rkyang gi gnas su gyar ba tshang mas mthong gsal yin/ dper na nga tshos thos par/ dol rgyal khog zhugs kyis kyang 7rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bur 'gal zla zhus na gtan nas mi 'grigs zhes bsnyungad kyi yod gnas 'dugayin na'ang srid don gyi gnad 'gag la thug par brten kho pa tshos gang la'ang ltos med kyis 'thab rtsod kyi mdung rtse de 7gong sa7skyabs mgon chen po mchog la gtad de bar lam (gtam drang bden rgya mtsho ) zer ba zhig blta na pa de'i nang (gong sa 7skyabasdo/ mgon sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po 7rgyal ba'i yang srid ngo ma ma red/ rdzun ma red)zer ba'i khungs med kyi gtam 'chal sna tsho gas bkod 'dug

ga3/ma pa/rang gnong gis rtsom pa ngo'i ming 'god ma nus par g.yo sgyu spyad de nga dang / nga tsho/ rgas po zer ba bcas kho pa gzhung zhabs rnying pa zhig gam/ 7rgyal ba'i yang srid gdan zhu'i gras su sku da mdog gi rdzun ma'i rnam pa bstan nas gzhan gyi yid ches yong thabs byas 'dug rung / skabs der yang srid gdan zhur phebs mkhan ni ser byes ke'u tshang rin po che dang / zhol gnyer khe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus/ nag chu mkhan po rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang bcas bzhi yin pa las kho pa'i grib gzugs tsam yang med/ yi ge de'i brjod bya'i nang don mgo mjug 'brel mi chags pa dang / skabs de'i gzhung srol 'gro stangs ci yang mi shes par rang 'dod rmongs pa'i glen rtags kyis spyi brtol bskyed de bris pa dper na/ (gus bod rgyal po'i ming can rwa sgreng bla mas 'go dmag hrag bsdu dang bcas pa rgyal ba'i yang srid 'khrul bral phebs bsur de ring rang thon rgyur nges yod/ sku ngo rnam pas kyang phebs sgrig zhu phyogs dang phebs bsur rim bcar gnang re bcas pa'i bka' rgya gnang 'dug) zer

———— /pa///re/ /pa//bakho/da pa da ga rang nas rdzun ma'i gdong ris dmar rjen gsal por mthong thub/ don snying deb de ni pha rol po'i brgyud skul dang smon log dam sri'i byed las zung du 'brel ba'i bod kyi bstan srid mi rigs bcas la ngo rgol rgyab gtod byed pa'i yig cha zhig yin stabs rang bzhin 'di mur 'jog thabs med pa ni nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di dang / lhag par da lta'i mi rabs kyi las 'gan chen po zhig yin/der brten nga tsho bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pas ma bskul dwang blangs kyis 'di skor ji ltar byed 'gab de snga'i gzhung zhabs mkhyen myong can dang / mkhas dbang sogs la bka' bsdur zhus par khong rnam pas nga tsho'i lhag bsam dang bya spyod la rgyab skyor chen po gnang ba dang 'brel lam ston gnang don/ kho pa tsho'i rdzun gtam la lan 'debs bya rgyu bden pas phongs pa med cing / tha na da byā/ slob grwa khag tu slob sbyong byed bzhin yod pa'i slob phrug na gzhon tshos kyang dgag lan 'bri thub

lnga pa/pa zhig red/ yin na'ang de 'dra'i spros pa ma dgos par nad brgya sman gcig gis 'thus pa'i dpe bzhin 7rgyal ba'i yang srid gdan zhu'i gras su phebs mkhran ngo ma khe smad dza sag bsod nams dbang 'dus mchog nas da lta'i gnas tshul 'di ma byung ba'i sngon te phyi lo 1968 lor bce mas pa (lhar bcas 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog 7skyabs mgo rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho chen po mdzadag thog mar rtsad dpyod ngos 'dzin gdan zhu ji zhus skor rang myong ma bcos lhug par bkod pa'i bden gtam rna ba'i bdud rtsi ) zhes bya ba'i phyag deb cig yod pa de bskyar du dpar 'grems gnang na yang srid gdan zhu'i skor 'di las lhag pa med ces dang / yang srid rin po che 'khru/ la med ngos 'dzin zhus rjes rngogong sa 7skyabs mgon chen sngo/ mchog nas da bar bod kyi bstan srid mi rigs dang bcas pa'i don du thog mar yi ge'i phyi mo ka kha gsan bzhed nas dbu tshugs te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcablo4 par gsan bsam mkhas pa'i yang rtser so na pa dang /'jig rten srid phyogs kyi bya ba dag kyang deng 'dzam gling gi che

drug pa/rgur grags pa phal mo ches gtsug tu bkur ba'i byung rabs kyi rim pa bcas sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa gsal bar 'khod pa bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs nas phyo lo 2000 lor 'don spel gnang ba3re (rgyal ba'i gsang gsum mdzad 'phrin la bsngags pa'i bstod chodags nor bu'i do shal/) zhes pa'i nang rtsom pa po mkhas dbang brag g.yab blo ldan shes rab rin po che'i bka' rtsom (7rgyal ba'i bka' drin dran bzhin ngo mtshar rmad byung gi mdzad par bstod pa ) zhes pa 'di'i nang don shin tu zab cing / yig tshogs nyung ba deng gi yul dus dang mthun pa ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa de chabs cig dpar skrun byas na yag po yong rgyu zhes gsung ba rgyu mtshan du malnga nga nas/ da res kyi go skabs 'di 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chenapo'i yang srid rin po che bla lha'i thugs dam bka' lung dang / lhag par 'dod khams bdag mo'i bla mtsho'i ngo mtshar mtsho mjal/ mchog sprul rin nge che'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mdzad pa sogs la dpyad pa rnam par dag pa zhus te tshang ma yid ches nges pa rnyed pa'i cad nas sngo sa

bdun pa/'dzin zhus pa'i skor dang / deng gi rlabs chen mdzad 'phrin bcas bod gzhis byes dang phyi phyogs bcas pa gang sar dril bsgrags rgya che zhu rgyu'i dus kyi bskul ma chen po zhig la brtsis te deb grangs 10000 dpar skrun 'grems spel zhus pa yin na / rgya che'i klog pa po rnam pas slob sbyong dang rang khongs 'brel yod tshang mar dril bsgrags rgya gang che dang 'brel rgyab gnyer rtsom 'bri dang / kha skong mthuno 'gyur gnang rgyu ci mchis 'di gar thad kar 'brel ba gnang skyang yad pa zhu rgyu/ched rtsom khag gnyis kyi brjod bya dang rjod byed gnyis ma dpe ji bzhin dpar skrun byas pa las 'di nas tshig zur tsam ya nga bzo ba〉〉sa zhus med pa bcas/bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pas/phyi lo 2004 zla 7 tshes 6 la/

r+sha brgyad pa/gleng gzhi/skyon su sti/'jigs rung srid pa'i mtsho chen 'khrugs pa'i 'jing //lam bzang 'khrul gyi gru bos myur brgal te//zag bral rin chen gling du srid bzung pa//skye rgu'i ded dpon shākya'i rgyal por bsngags//kun tu dge ba mchog rab dam pa'i nor//'gro la rjes chags snying rje bdud rtsi'i klung //thig ler 'khyil pa'i cha rdzogs zla ba gsar//'jig rten dbang phyug phan bde'i gter du bsngags//gser ldan tha gru yangs pa'i 'khor yug tu//lugs gnyis khrims bzang rtsibs stongs 'khor lo che//lus can kun dger sbyor ba'i sgyu 'phrul mkhan//stobs kyi 'khor bsgyur mes dbon rnam gsum bsngags//

dgu pa/'khrul bral ngag la dbang du 'byor ba'i dpal//mi zad blo gter kun bzang rgyal ba'i mdzod//yongs sman rgya chen chos kyi rol mdza de//bsil ldan gangs ri mdzes pa'i rgyan du bsngags//ngag rig la dbang slo gros bzang po'i gter//rgyal bstan lha ra 'dzin rgya cher mdzes pa'i mtsho//srid 'dir sa gsum dbang du bsgyur ba'i mgon//'dren mchog mtshungs pa med pa'i sde la 'dud//dpyad gsum dri bral dngul dkar me long du//ma 'dres ma nor gzugs snang 'bum bkra zhing //'jigs bral gdong la'i khri la 'dod byung gi/ngabasam 'phel nor bus mdzes pa'i byung ba gleng //zhes yul dam par bstod cing bsngags pa dang / dngos po nges bstan gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng ba sngon du btang nas/de yang gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i srogs shing sa steng rgyal bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag 'phags mchog phyag na pasdud

bsange pa/thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor mi yi rnam par rol pa 7gong sa sku phreng na rim gyi mdzad pa'i bye brag so skye'i blo yi spyod yul las 'das pa rnams rnam thar gyi glegs bam zhib rgyas su sku(nga ba bzhin 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen 11 mchog gis sems can rgya mtsho'i rgyud du bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon rma med par 'jog pa'i phyir gsang gsum ngo mtshar gyi mdzad bzang rlabs chen ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i rnam par thar pa mthong thos tsam gyis yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa dag ni gnas lnga rig pa'i dran dbang rnams kyi snyan dngags dam pa'i mdzod las thon par 'gyur ba bo ra ma chags kyang / thog mar mchog sprul bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po gangs ljongs skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi skal bar rtsad dpyod gdan zhu ji ltar zhus lugs skar rnams byung ba la ma byung dang / ma byung ba la byung tshul gyi bsre lhad bri gang med pa zhig byung na dbe/ mtshan che lugs kyi gzhen bskul mdzad po snga phyi byung ba 'di skor rang nyid blo gros rnam dpyod kyi 'jug sgo dman la gzhung dang rig gnas gang cir

bcu gcigasbyang brtson nyams myong shin tu dbul rkyen tshig sbyor brda dag sogs gang thad nas spyir btang nag sngo 'bru bsher rang skya 'pher min tsam las med pa'i thodag skabs der nyin jo zhib 'god byas khul gyi yig rigs rnams bod du lus pa dang / da cha na tshod babs kyis rlung khams brjed ngas che bas snga phyi'i 'byung tshul phra zhib blor nges dka' ba sogs cad kun nas rmongs pa'i rang mtshang rjen par gsal thodan mkhyen ldan rnams kyis 'phya dmod bzhad gad kyi yul nyid ma galta gas dgyes bskyed gzigs mo'i mtshadad sprin du 'gyur ba zhig yong rgyu'i re ba ring du bral mod/ der lta na'ang zi ling khul rtsad dpyod du phebs mi mtshan zhabs dar han ser byes ke'u tshang rin po che dang / sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin rnam gnyis khyodan gshegs zin pa dang / rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang lha sar rgya dmar gyi btsan codag tu lus pa bcas kyis rtsad dpyod gdan zhu mdzad po'i khongs nas rgya gar sa thodag tu slebs 'byor nged rang gcig pu las med cing / de yang da cha na snu da ches mtho'i dbang gis yun 'tsho'i re ba bral gshis

bcu gnyis/rang thog gnas tshul dngos myong gang nges rnams kyang yig lam du ma bkod par phyi rabs rnams la mun nag 'doms 'jal gyi yul du lus tshe shin tu phangs pa'i gnas la brten rang myong rang gis brjod par sus kyang bsnyon du ci mchis snyam pa'i lhag bsam rma med kyi sgo nas spyi brtol ches cher bskyed de gang dran gang nges rnams snon 'phri'i bsre lhad kyi dri mas ma gos par phal tshig go gang bde'i tshul du 'god par bya ba lags so//

1le'u dang po/7gong sa 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal ba'i tshul bstan dang / rgyal tshab gsar bsko/7gong sa bka' drin zla med rdo rje 'chang sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mchos chen lnga mchog nas snurdzis srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bdag gir bzhes te bstan pa rgyas thabs dang / chab srid phra tshugs thabs/ chab 'bangs rnams bde bar ngal 'tsho thub pa'i thabs tshul sogs mdzad 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mthu nyid las bod ljongs rang btsan snga sor chud pa sogs kyi gnas lugs zhus langs bral ba byings che da lam 'dir zhu skabs su ma che zhing /ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gsal ler gzigs pa'i mdzad pa'i bye brag rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus nas skabs su babs pa rtswa rtse'i zil pa tsam zhu

2 na / de sngon phyi lo 1920 nang rtse pho brang chen wa'i shar brgyud nyams gso mdzad skabs gzim chung nub lngaras phebs skas galas g.yon rtsig pa nub phyogs su rgya bya khyodan po zhig dang / shar phyogs su 'brug dkar po gcig bcas dmigs bsal gyis 'bri bkod gnang ba skabs der lha bris dbu chen sku gas bsam yod rnams nas lo rgyus khungs lung gang yang med pa'i ri mo 'di 'dra dgongs gzhi dgos pa ji yin rjes ya mtshan lta bu brtsi rgyu byung song rung / rjes su zhib skabs nub kyi bya sngon po de bzhin sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po mchog nyid chu bya lor dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal tshul bstan rgyu yin pa dang / shar gyi 'brug dkar po de bzhin sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog lcags 'brug lor gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol zhu rgyu bcas shar nub sa yul dang / lo rtags khams mdog gang ci 'phyug 'dzol med par gsal rjen du 'god gnang mdzad yod pa kun gyi mthong chod thog de rjes chu sprel lo gdan sa chen po 'bras ser dga' gsum dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya spyi mgrin nas zhabs brtan gasdugel 'debs zhus pa'i bka' lan spyi stsal du/ ngos thog mar sngar srol gser bum

2didakrug 'dodan ma dbo sa par lung brtag don gsal/ srid zhi'i 'dren mchodag rgyal dbang gi skye gral du brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin gyis gdan khrir 'khod nas bzung bar skabs sngon byon mdzad lam gzhir bzung rgyal tshab sku ngas 'dzin rta tshag ho thog thu dang / mkhan chen sku1ngas 'dzin rdo rje 'chang phur lcog rin po ches dbus bshes gnyen dam pa gtsug bsten chodas khyodad kyis mchosan 'don kha khral blo 'dzin khyodar sbyangs/rab byung / dge tshul sdom nod/ gzhung chen bka' bod lngar brgal brtag rtsod grwa maro/ rgyud rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang dbang bka'/ khrid sku gas rang gi blo tshod dang bstun pa'i nyin ltar chags med du brtson sbyang gang 'tshams bskyed khul yang rang 'o/ bce brgyad la babs 'tshams sngar sku la la bsnyad pa'i rgyal srid kyi 'gan 'khur the ga tu babs pa na rang la chodas srid gang thad nas myong goms shes yon dman yang lha sde mi sdes spyi zhus khur du blangs te rang nyid dal sdod skyid sdod kyi dbang med bstan srid kyi bde snga na la nyin mtshan sems 'khur lci bas non bzhin du bstan pa rgyas thabs/ chab srid phra ṭa/gas thabs/ chab 'bangs bde bar ngal 'tsho thabs lhag bsam drang pos gzhung bsrang

4sgo gsum yod rgu rtsal sprugs bgyis rung / shing 'brug lor dbyin je'i dpung dmag lhags 'byor skabs kyang rang nyid skyid thabs ngo srung mthun lam byas tshe chab srid la phugs lhaman chag na rkang rjes lag bsub gang min yong rgyur bsams/ sngar 7bo nga sa lnga pa chen ngo nas man ju rgyal po dang mchod yon bkur res 'brel nas bzungs da bar phan tshun skyong 'os la brten/ 'phral phugs bde sdug lhong nges zhu bar ngal ba khyad bsad kyis byang 'grims rgya sog yul gru brgyud pe cing gser gyi rgyal khab chen por bo nga ma yum sras mjal 'phrad bkur bzos bdag rkyen tshad med pa gnang yang / ring por ma lon par gong ma yum sras rim gshegs rjes sku nga ma sna na sgyu ji khrir 'kho da yab sras la rgyu rkyen lhong gsol thog bod ljongs snying la bcangs te phyir 'khod skabs bod sdod am ban nas g.yo zhus rjes 'brangs lu'u cun dpon dmag lha 'gyor bod ljongs chab srid kyi dbang byus 'phrog nyer rgyal blon chab srid kyi dbang lung yod pa rnams rgya gar 'phags yul du ngal ba rim spangs bde 'kho da kyis dbyin gzhung brgyud rgya gzhung la gang ci'i rgyu rkyen mtha' 'bud dang / phyogs gcig nas bstan srid bde

5thabs zhabs rim lta da med bskrubs pa'i las 'bras mi bslu'i bden nus zab mosgos rgya nag nang 'khrugs dus 'gyur dbang gi bod phyogs rgya dpon dmag ltag gru chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar rim gyis mthar skrod thog rang gis skyong yul bod jongs kyi zhing sar slar 'khod de chu glang nas bzung chu sprel bar bod ljongs 'di nyid du bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal gsar du bzhad pas mchog dman tshang mas dga' bde ci dgar 'o/ngas rjodad bag phebs su tshim pa 'dis mtshon phra zhib yig lam dang /lha sde mi sde mchog dman kun gyi blor rtogs gsal ltar zhib cha 'god rgyur yig cho gas kyi rgyur bsams rags tsam bskadad pa 'di dag bka' drin bsam shes 'the da chung spyodag shes bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sgyu garang nyid nas chab srid la 'khur bskyed kyi phan cha byung srid yod na yid mthun 'dod pa khengs nges las/ byas yus dang ngo gso 'byung re'i bsam pa til 'bru tsam med cing / da skabs su'ang na tshod babs dang bcas chos srid kyi 'khur spangs te tshe mjug 'dir dge sbyor kho nar gcig 'grus tshe phyi ma shul thag ring ba'i rnam dkar rgyab skyor sgrub rgyu nyag gcig blo yul du 'char yang / gtso bo lus dang grib ma bzhin

6'grogs pa'i lha srung dang / skyabs yul bla ma chodas dang zang zing gi 'brel pa thogs pa'i mchog dman chab 'bangs kun nas 7cadas la kha tsam min pa'i snying nas re bcol bgyis pa'i spyi dodan chodas gtong ma 'o/da par da lta'ang rang gi shes nus lcogs hrūd 'khur bskyed skabs su mchis pa da cha 15sa bgrang cha nga brgyad du nye bas lo shas ring las chodas srid kyi 'khur ring snga ra sngo mi lnga gas pa tshang mas shes nges bo bas chod pa bzhin/ da lta khad nye'i rgyal khab rgya gar gzhung dang / rgya gzhung gnyis phyo gas su dpung stobs btsan pas mthun lam gang zab/ zhe 'kho na 'dzin pa'i sa mtshams chung khag la pha mo la po'i mabo gnon ched dpung dmag go hrag de yang dmag rtsed phugs 'pher gzhan sde non nges/ lhag par deng skabs snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs kun nas dar zhing / yang sgos dmar po'i las lugs ches cher b.ro/ bas rje btsun dam pa'i skyed srid brtsad gcod mi chog pa dang / chos byed dgon sde khag gi mchodad rgyun rtsa 'arngo ga gis dge 'dun pa dmag mir bcug pas mcho na rgyal bstan ming med du bathodam pa nā khu ral gyi las lugs ji byung go thos byung dang 'byung mus kyi srol ltar 'byung 'gyur dbus

7ljongs chos srid gnyis ldan gyi zhing 'dir yang phyi nang gang sa nas lhags par nges pas de skabs rang sa srung ma nus na/ rgyal ba yab sras kyis mtshon bstan 'dzin skyes 'phags rnams ming med du bather+sham zhing / bla brang khag dang / bstan 'dzin chos byed dge 'dun gyi sde'i 'dzin dbang mchod rgyun dang bcas pa rtsa brlag chodas rgyal mes dacadan rnam gsum gyi bzhed rgyun chab srid kyang ming tsam du nyams dmas 1sgog 'di ga'i zhabs 'bring kun kyang pha gzhis rgyu nor rtsa 'phrogs dgra ya'i bran du dbang med du 'khyams shing / yid can kun kyang mnar gcod 'jigs skrag gi du khas nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i dus shig 'byung nges pas bstan srid kyi spyi don phyin ci ma log pa da lta bde skyid ches dar mi smon rang skyid rang lag tu yod pa'i skabs 'dir slad zhi drag gang la'ang thabs shes lu gu brgyud gang thad nas ma lan ma 'gyod pas lag tu bstar thub pa'i chab srid kyi bde thabs zhabs 'bring ser skya rnams kyi sri zhur rag lus shing / bod ljongs spyi'i bde thabs ser skya mchog dman dang / chab 'bangs kun nas bsam gzhigs ma 'a1rdol ba gcig 'grus 'phyar ba gru 'degs dgos pa nges par 'khur du babs pa bzhin

8spang blang 'dzol med 'byung na gzhung bsten dgra lha'i gtso bo nas slob dngo na mthodang ba dodan ldan gyi thugs bzhed dang mthun pa'i sri zhu sgrub na gang la'ang ya nga bag tsha med ces pa mthun sdudags kyi don la sor gnas su nges pas 7lnga sa nas bstan srid spyi wa na yid bsam dang mthun 'jug gi las la ngo lkog med par sri zhur balca na pa rnams la skyabs 'jug rjes 'dzin dang / lam 'gro'i 'phrin las dngos su bstan cing / tshul min rnams la bya ba lam 'a〈sna zhan pas bka' chad phog nges pa ma zad/ gnas skabs rang don sgrub phyogs phyo gas lhung ngo srung las chab srid kyi bde dodan da mus bzhin yal sku la 'ba' zhig gis 'khur du ma blangs na phugs don mi 'grub pa mthong gsal ltar/ slar ci drag gis 'gyodad kyang phan cha mi srid pas ngos nam 'tsho'i ring la bod ljongs bde thabs da mus kyis khyol ba mthong / phugs rang rang myong bya gong smos rnams so so'i thog tu smin pa ni ngos rang gi nyams myong rgyu mtshan gsal po'i steng nas gzhan la 'dosnams pa 'di lhag bslab bya lhug por ston rgyu med pas phyi'i rim gro bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin pa yin cing / gtso cher nang gi zhabs brten rim gro 'di nyid

9snying la lcags bskul tshang mas sngar 'khyedad phyis sgyu ma gyi sri zhu tshags tshud skrub nus na ngos nas kyang gang 'khyodal gyi bar bstan pa chab srid 'phral yun rgyas thabs/ zhabs 'bring kun kyang ming dodan gnyis mtshungs kyis rjes 'dzin/ chab 'bangs kun kyang sngar mus bde skyid bzang pos ngal 'chos ba'i dus ston bzang po lo brgya phrag bar gnas thabs kyi zhe brtson sngar bzhin bgyid rgyur spyi don nang gi rim thod 'di lhag ma mchi/ spyi zhus kyi lho ba ston de rang lags pas thodang dodan rnams la nyin dang / mtshan mo'i spyod lam rnam bzhi gang gi skabs su'ang brtag dpyad nan tan gyis spang blang ma 'dzol ba gal che ba lags so/zhes blangs dor zhu sgo'i bka' slob dang 'brel ba'i ma 'ongs lung bstan bden pa lag bzhag tu stsal ste gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chodas la bskul ba sogs dgongs gzhi dathodas pa du ma'i slad du phyi lo (1933) lnga da rgyal 'esgo (2060) chu bya zla 10 tshes 30nyin dgung grangs lnga bcu nga brgyad thog re zhig dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim tshul bstan pas bod ljongs skye rgu mtha' dag sdug bsngal mun pa'i gcong rong chen por lhang /

10 de nas chab srid 'dzin skyong mdzad phyogs skor srid blon dang /bka' shag bod jongs cho gas 'du rgyas 'alhungams bcas bka' bsdur snga phyi rim nan gnang ba'i mtha' don rgyal tshab tu dga' ldan khri pa mi nyag a mi dang / rwa sgreng rin po che/ phur cog rin po che bcas bla ma che khag gsum rtse 'phags mchog lo ke sha ra'i spyan sngar gzan brtag gnang ste rwa sgreng ho thog thu thon pa rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol gyis srid sdudan yab gzhis glang mdun gung kun dga' dbang phyug yod mus dang re zhig phyag sbrel mdzad de srid 'gan bskyangs/thub dbang bstan pa rgya cher 'khyil ba'i mchod//srid dang bral yang srid pa'i tshul can du//mi mngon bskadad pa bsdu ba'i thun gsum smag/bsil ldan 'od snang gzhil ba'i gshed du che//cadan kyang dus kyi kun gsal mdzes rgyan du—//'phags chen dam pa'i bzhed dgongs 'od rlabs phreng //'byed mkhas sa skyodang zla ba gsar pa zhig/skye rgu'i kun da dar ba'i gnyen du 'phel//
11snying rje'i gter chen mtshan dpe'i nyi gzhon gsar//bsod nams shar ri'i mgron du re ba'i 'gror//rab dkar snang ba'i lam bzang mtshon byed pa'i// byā 'phrin las ga bur zegs ma cham du brdal//

12le'u gnyis pa/ macog sprul yang srid rin po che rtsad dpyod mdzad phyogs/7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku gdung rin po che/zhal lha gzigs su bzhugs su gsol yod par rang 'gul gyis shar phyogs lan gnyis gcus pa dang / gzhung brten dgra lha'i gtso bo gnas chung chos rgyal chen 1sgo dang / dga' gathesteng gnas srung chen po/ bsam yas gasna da sbyin chen sngo sogs spyan 'dren mdzad skabs shar phyogs su gus 'dud mjal dar 'bul 'phang mdzad pa/ byang shar mtshams nam mkha'i glang po chags stangs gzugs dbyibs mi 'dra ba mang lnga byung ba/ lha sa gsung chos ra ba'i shar phyogs rdo skas kyi srub nas/'brug me tog skyes pa/ 7rgyal mchog sku 7gong ma'i gser sdong dge legs 'dod 'jo gsar bzhengs gnang skabs mchod sdong lha khang gi

1ho byang shar ka ring shing skam rdo bteg can gyi srub nas slo bur dkar sha chen po skar ma dang / sha ba'i rwa co 'dra ba skyes pa dus 'gyur ma byung bar dngos su mjal rgyu sku da pa sogs rtags mtshan cad du ma nas mchodag sprul yang srid rin wa che byang shar phyogs su zhal gzigs mo da par nges pa rnyed/lha sa'i shar lho'i mtshams nyin lam bcu tsam la chodas 'khor rgyal du rgyal mchodag sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mchodas dag pa ye shes kyi gzigs snga ra shar ba dang mthun par gnas sgo gsar dbye mdzad pa'i dpal ldan lha mo ri ma ti'i bla mtsho dad ldan rnams kyis mjal tshe ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi blang dor rnams pra phab gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bar ston pa'i rtsa che yod pa dang / bla mtsho de nas/de sgyu na 7rgyal mchog 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i yang sprul rtsad dpyod skabs kyang 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i 'khrungs khyim sogs zhib cha gsal bar bstan pas mtshon mtsho mjal khyad dzadzis ngo mtshar che ba yod par brten/ skabs der rgyal tshab la bod ljongs chos srid gnyis ldan gyi rgyal khab chen po'i chab srid 'dzin spel spyi dang / bye

14brag spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mabo na chen po'i yang srid 'phrul bral nges rnyed rtsad dpyod mdzad rgyu las lhag pa'i don gal che ba gzhan du med gshis phyi 'e1 1935 bod rgyal lo 2062 shing phag 'e1 rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che chos 'khor rgyal du phebs/ lha mo'i bla mtsho yod sar gsol 'debs spyodan lam gnang ste nyin grangs mang po zhib gzigs skabs rim pas mtsho'i nang nas dbu can gyi yig 'bru ‘‘a ka ma ’’zhes dang / de rjes dgon pa thog sa gsum brtsegs bar thog g.yu rtse can gyi yang steng gser zangs kyi rgya phibs yod pa/ dgon pa de'i shar phyogs 'gro lam skya thal ler ri chung zhig gi rtsa bar thug pa / de'i thad khang pa thog gcig ma thog lnga na po byas pa gcig bcas gzigs pa rnams yi ger 'god gnang gis re zhig gsang rgya mdzad/de nas yang srid rtsad dpyod 'tshol zhib byed po shar phyogs yul gyu khag la phebs rgyur gtan 'khel gyis gdan sa 'bras se dga' gsum gyi bla sprul drag 'dems khag gnas chung chos rgyal chen por lung brtag zhu gnang la shar lho'i phyogs dang / dwags po khul phur lcog byams mabo na rin po che dang / shar phyogs chab mdo sogs mdo

15khams yas mas su ser byes har gdong khang ser rin po che/ a mdo a rig sogs byang shar khul du ser byes har gdong ke'u tshang rin po che bcas la thugs gtan 'khel te phur lcog rin po che'i phyag rogs zhabs zhu rtse drung thub bstan byang chub dang / chang khyim thub bstan tshe 'phel/ (yid ches ma dngul do dam deng skabs ka la ka tar bzhugs pa de red/) shod drung phun ram pa bcas dang / ser byes khang ser rin po che'i phyag rogs zhabs zhu rtse mgron bstan pa 'byung gnas dang / rtse drung las tshan tshul khrims chos 'phel/ shod drung las tshan 'bri yu ba/ ser byes har gdong ke'u tshang rin po che'i phyag rogs zhabs zhu gus pa zhol gnyer khe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus dang /nag chu mkhan po rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang bcas lngar las bzhi re tsho khag gsum bgos kyis gtong gnang mdzad gtan 'khel zhing / bsam yas chos skyong spyan 'dren skabs bka' shag tu yang srid rtsad dpyod zhu mir bskur rgyu'i thugs gsal me long zhig 'bul gnang mdzad pa skabs de'i chos skyong nas bka/'a lung gnang srol med rkyen gong khag gsum sur bskur thugs dogs

ma /////ji mim chod par bsam yas ar po'i do dam sku bcar dza sag rgyal mtshan phun tshogs dang / tha'i ji bshan kha ba (chos don bka' bzur rda ram sa lar lnga lam du bzhud/) gnyis bsam yas su yod mus la bskyar du dogs gcod zhu rgyur ched stsal skabs ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las la bskur dgos kyi brda ston gnang 'dug don thugs gsal de dang / brtag dpyad zhu ched 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i phyag phreng ser po gcig dang / nag po gcig gsol zhabs rnams la gsung brda gnang byed ba so'i rnga chung lta bu yu ldan gcig sba'i phyag 'khar gcig bcas dang / paṇa chen sku gong ma/ zi ling kru'u zhi rma sbu phang / sku 'bum bla spyi sogs khul de'i bla dgon dpon rigs che khag so sor srid tham bka' yig rten chas/ gsang ba'i sgo nas mtsho gzigs gang byung gi shog lhe bcas rtsis sgrod gnang /dbang phyogs bsod nams lhun po'i gtsug rgyan du//rab gsal nyi gzhon 'char ba'i dge mtshan 'od//rang gir gshis su rdzogs pa'i rten 'byung dang //brtag thub tshad ma'i bden tshig dbyangs su gyer//

17lkog 'gyur kun mthong rab dwangs nor bu'i mtshor//yi ge'i brda thabs gsal ba'i 'bru phreng gis//sa skyong thugs la ya mtshan 'phrul gyis ris//kun dge'i lam bzang mtshon pa'i ngo mtshar gsal//'dab brgya'i snying po 'tshol ba'i rkang drug khyu//phyogs mthar 'phur ljing rang rtsal ngom pa'i khrod//sa mtha' 'grim la gshog rtsal dman bdag kyang //bsod nams yangs pa'i mkha' la lhan cig 'grod//

18le'u gsum pa/a mdo khul rtsad dpyod mdzad stangs dang thugs gtan khel ༷/gas/phyi lo 1936 bod rgyal lo 2063 me byi zla 9 tshes 5 nyin ser byes har gdong ke'u tshang rin po ches gtsos phran tsho ngo las rnams lha sa nas lnga na rgyu'i snga nub sngar ma grags pa'i kha ba chen po babs te nam langs mtshams phran rang jo mjal du bskyod skabs lam srang khag tu kha ba rkang pa'i bol nub tsam slebs sheng / chu tshod dgu tsam la ke'u tshang rin po che bzhugs yul gzim shag rdo ring du ngo las tshang ma mnyam 'jo/mas kyis dasngaras gzhi rdog thon skabs nam mkha' g.ya' dwangs nyi ma'i 'od snang gsal bas kha ba rnams bzhu ste bgrod bde ba sogs gnam gshis ngo mtshar che ba tshang mas ya mtshan du byed pa zhig byung song / de nas 'brom stod dang / lcags ri phra mo sogs brgyud/ nag chu rdzong du 'byor zhing / der rten chas 'gel

19khal sogs go bsgrigs kyis nyin bcu lha ra bzhugs rjes sku ga tsan dan dgon dang / rma la bzhi/ khyung po steng chen sogs brgyud ri bo che bar phebs yul khag la rdza ri dang / nags tshal 'ga' shas tsam las/phal cher ne+e'u gsing spang ljongs mang ba nyin re la re rgyag dgos la sang nyin la che ba zhig yong na do nub mtshan gang ngam/ yang na zhogs pa sngo na nas zhag sar ma slebs bar kha ba rtag tu babs te mi khal tshang mar dka' ngal che tsam byung rung / 'chi rkyen sogs god kha ngan pa gang yang ma byung zhing / nged rang skabs der rkang par gangs phyis brgyab rkyen deng sang yang dgun dus rkang pa phran bu 'khyags rkyen byung na rma thon yong mus/ kha ba rtag tu babs pa de ni gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i srog shing 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i yang srid rin po che 'khrul bral lag son gdan zhu thub rgyu'i rten 'brel gyi la nye mchodag tu bzang bar khums/ skabs der skye rgu mdor bod dang / zi ling stod rgya dmag 'khrugs byung ste yun ring ma song rkyen ri bo che nas lam rkyang shar phebs gnang slos bzod min la brten 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin lnga che rdo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mchog skye rgu mdor zhabs

20 'khod zin gshis bzo cho gang 'dra yod min bka' slob zhu snyan 'bul gnang gis ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las gzhan rnams ri bo cher bzhugs shing / nged rang mdo spyi dza sag rnam gnyis la phran tsho'i phebs phyogs skor bka' slob zhu rgyu dang / mdo spyi dza sag zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan nged rang gi bcen por brten mjal 'phrad zhu ched chab mdor bcar/ zla gcig tsam song rjes kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' lan dang bstun lcags zam kha dang / sho mda'/ nang chen sogs brgyud skye rgu mdor bod zla 12 tshes 29 nyin 'byor/me glang zla 1 tshes 2 nyin 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i dgung gsar mdzad chen thog 'byor phyag zhus te sred dam snyan rgya dang /rten chas rnams phul/ de rjes gzim chung mjal kha'i thog 7kun gzigs mchog nas ke'u tshang rin po cher mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi yang srid rin po che 'khrul bral nges pa rnyed pa zhig ma byung thu med la brten ngos rang sku 'bum du sdod skabs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo nas rtsad dpyod byas par khye'u mtshan ltas bzang ba gsum byung lugs kyi bka' mngags dang 'brel mtshan lnga shog lhe gnang zhing / nang ma

21khang du mgron che brgyud ngo las tshang 'dzoms sar 7kun gzigs mchodag nas rtsad dpyod gnang ba'i gnas lugs dang bcas khyed rnams de skor ched mngags la brten ngos nas 'tshol rnyed de tsam ma yin par nye 'gyangs gang sar rtsad dpyod ru nga zhib tshags dgos rgyu dang / 'di nas grogs 'gyur zhu mir tshe chog gling sprul sku dang / dngul chu sprul sku gnyis gtong rgyu'i thog 'gel khal sdeng min rigs kyang ring min rnga bong 'byor rgyur phyir log dang stabs mtshungs bskyod 'gab sogs bka' slob dang 'brel bkras sding las tshan pa/ sne shan du bsko bzhag gnang ('di rjes su lha 'gyor dza sag gces 'jigs med zer ba de red/) kha ba babs zhod che bas rnga bong 'phral 'byor ma thub par gang 'tshams 'gor ba 'gyor 'phral g.yog rigs 'ga' shas dang / rten chas mo gas 10na btang gis sngo ma rnams zla ba gsum pa nang rdog thon gyis ra nyag dgon dang / lab dgon/ de nas stong 'khor nye mtshams bar yul grong dang / rtsi shing nags tshal sogs med pa'i byang stong 'ba' zhig la brten zhag tshugs so sor sdod gur phub ste mtsho skya reng sngo reng sogs brgyud nyin nyi shu skor nas stong 'khor mkhar du 'byor

22skabs zi ling sgar dpon tshe gling sde 'chang gis gtsos bod rigs tshong khag gi bsu ma rta pa bco lnga skor 'byor zhing / der bca' zhag gcig gnang ste phebs skabs chu nag spang khar sku 'bum bla spyi'i thab bsu'i sding gur che ba'i nang gral 'khod kyis gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang /mjal dar bcas gnang / de nas bla spyi brgyad kyis gtsos sgar pa brgyad cu sogs kyis bsu mi rta pa drug cu skor dang bcas phyi lo 1937 bod rgyal lo 2064 me glang zla 4 tshes 10 nyin sku 'bum byams pa gling dgon du 'gyor/ de nyin sprin dkar gzugs dbyibs mi 'dra ba mang sngo dang / char zim phran bu babs pa sogs rtags mtshan shin tu bzang 11 byung ba ma zad/ sku 'bum dgon gyi bkod pa rnams 'dren byed kyi yul du mjal ma thag 'di snyam du/ma la/ srid gsum bdag morware bla masnu ra gsal ba'i dgon pa de phal cher 'di rang yin pa gor ma chag snyam pa'i dga' ba dang /yang srid mchog gi sprul sku myur rnyed ngal ba don ldan gyi skal bzang zhig yong re chen po byung / sku 'bum dgon du ke'u tshang rin po che che shos sgar pa dang / nged rang zhol gnyer khe smad sras a dkar sgar

23pa / nag chu mkhan po rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin dang / rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang gnyis a ja si sgar pa/ tshe mchog gling sprul sku gser khri sgar pa dang / dngul chu spral sku mi nyags sgar pa bcas so sor bca' sdod byas/ sku 'bum 'di bzhin sngar yul grong sogs med pas 'brog sde'i khrod du rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi yi gar du zlos pa 'jam mgon tsong kha chen po bsam bzhin skyu bltams pa'i lte khrag las 'khrungs pa'i tsan dan gyi sdong po dang / rgyal ba seng ge nga ro'i sku 'bum sogs snying por bzhugs pa'i gseng sdong chen po dang / mdun du tsan dan de las rtsa ba mched pa'i sdong po lo ma dang /shun pa'i bar du rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i sku dang a ra pa tsa'i yig 'bru gsal ba'i khyad chos ngo mtshar che ba/ bka' srung ce)sa rgyal gsung dregen ma/ dbosgon gyi phyogs bzhir rang byon gyis mtshan pa'i gnas phyogs bzhi sogs byin rlabs g.yang du chags pa'i lum bi'i tshal gnyis pa/ phyag na pad+mo bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag rjes sku 'bum dga' ldan byams pa gling zhes grags pa'i zla ris phyogs kyi sgeg mo'i 'gram par mdzes shing / thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa chen po dang 7rgyal

24mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mchos sogs kyi 'bas sen gyi pad+mo rnam par bkod de byin gyi brlabs pa'i dgon chen/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun zhal grangs 3500 skor rnam kun rgyun tshogs mawa sngags bshad sgrub kyi chos spyod 'phel zhing /dus chen khag la mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang / rgyud pa/ dus 'khor/ sman pa bcas grwa tshang khag bzhi so so'i skabs bstun mchod 'bul/ sgrub mchod sogs chags med spyi dang / bye brag cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i bco lnga mchod pa'i nub mo 'du khang che mo'i mdun nas 'khor yug tu mchod pa che chung nyi shu skor bstar bsgrigs kyi mchod pa thams cad rgyan spros bzo bkod shin tu legs shing / lhag par sgo mang yig cha dang / ser byes rje btsun pa'i yig cha'i phar phyin skabs dang po'i 'dzin gra gnyis kyi mchod pa khag gnyis la ston pa'i mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khrishing se gas gzugs 'gros phal cher zangs skud kyi sner mar gyi 'bur bzos bzo bkod lag rtsal phun sum chodags pa gzhan gyis do zla bral ba lta bur snang /bod zla 5 pa'i nang yin tshod la ke'u tshang rin po ches dbus

rten(( ————nged tsho tshang ma zi ling du phebs te paṇa chen don byed las khang du bzhugs/ de'i 'gan 'dzin a mdo a khu brtson 'grus zer bar zi ling khul rgyus mnga' zhib par 'dug /zi ling rmā kru'u zhir mjal 'phrad zhus chog pa zhu gnang la nyin gsum bzhi zhig lan gsal gang yang ma byung zhing / de rjes gnang nyin mja' 'phrad du yong 'thus dang /mgron brgyud byed po'i bsam 'char yin khul gyis rten chas rnams bstar bsgrigs kyis 'khyer 'bul byas na legs lugs zer don zi ling du yod pa'i bod rigs tshong pa rnams bos te rten chas gser dngul dang / gos chen zar babs/ bskyin khebs/ snam bu/ spos/legs zher/ sha ra/ gla rtsi/ pags rigs sogs mi rer sna re bskur te bstar bsgrigs kyis khrom gzhung brgyud ya mon du phebs/phran tsho mgron khang nang sgug sdod skabs thag ring zhig nas dril brda chen po btang sdudang bas rgya mi rnams gcig thon gnyis thon gyis mgron khang phyi nang du nged tsho rkyang par lus/ dril brda de bzhin skabs der 'jar par dang rgya mi gnyis dmag 'khrugs yong mus la brten 'jar pan gyi gnam gyu yong gi yod pa'i skad brda yin 'dug cing / de nyin

26dacadas su gnam gru sleb pa byung ma song / ngang tsam nas rgya mi rnams rim 'gyor rjes kru'u zhi rmā spu phang ngo mjal gyis bka' rten rnams bstar 'bul dang 'brel bas gnas lugs zhib zhu gnang / ja thang dang / shing tog sogs phul thog /khyed rnams lam bgrod bde phebs thub pa gang legs sogs mtshams 'dri dang / 'di gar gsungs 'os rigs phrin mi tru'u krang brgyud gsung dgos sogs zer/ de'i sang nyin thing krang bzhi dang / phrin mi sru'u krang sogs mjal 'phrad mtshams rtags gnang / de nas sku 'bum du phyir phebs kyis sku 'bum bla spyi dang / bla sprul che khag rnams la bka'ayig rten chas rnams rim 'bul gnang /mar ston rgya bal bgrod pa'i smre ngag tu//dran na glo ba 'dar ba'i lam 'phrang zhes//skyo ba'i thugs ris mgrin mtshor shar ba ltar//bgrod dka'i gangs lar ngal dub ring du myong //kun gzigs cho sa kyi nyi ma'i ye shes rlabs//lnga ldan 'ja' zer dgod pa'i bka' yi lung //

27mos gus 'dab brgya ngang gis grol ba ni//phan bde'i skyed tshal rgyas pa'i rtsa lag nyid//thub chen 'jam dpal rdo rje tsong kha pa//mtshan dper rol ba lum bi'i dga' tshal du//ngo mtshar ltas kyi re khaḥbakod bzhin du//dbugs 'byin ngal bso'i bde bar longs su rol//

28le'u bzhi pa/zi ling khul rtsad dpyod zhu stangs dang /thugs gtan khel 'u/gas/de nas nga tsho ngo las khag bgos kyis ke'u tshang rin po che bya khyung dang / ra khog sku 'bum 'tsho drug khul dang / nga rang mtsho sngon phyogs mda' bzhi/ 'khyams ru/ rkang tsha khul sku gas/ sku zhabs mkhyen rab bstan 'dzinadang / slo bzang tshe dbang gnyis dpa' ris mchod rten thang dgon dang / zha dmar/ stag lung / rab rgyas khul bcas la phebs pa phyir 'khor lhan 'dzoms ma thub par zla ba phyed gnyis tsam 'gor/ nga rang 'gro yul gyi dpon khag so sor bka' rten rnams phul te zhib rtsad byas par pha ma so sos rang 'dod rmi ltas byung tshul dang / sbra khyim la 'ja' zug tshul sogs brjod mi re gnyis las/yongs grags yid ches nges pa brnyed pa gang yang ma byung zhing / gzhan dag phebs khungs khag nas kyang yongs grags yid ches ngo mtshar che

29rigs mi 'dug kyang / phran bu'i rgyu mtshan brjod rgyu yod pa khyi'u bcu gnyis tsam byung / paṇa chen rin po che nas khyi'u gsum yod gsungs pa'i gatherga bo ni phyi bya ('di sngar bod chos rgyal mes dbon skabs zi ling khul du mtha'i so kha srung ba'i phyi so nang so mang yod khongs phyi'i bya ra ba'i ming 'jags tshod/)stag 'tsher du sku bltams pa'i da lta'i 7thodang sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / gcig ni paṇa chen rin po ches dus 'khor dbang chen gnang skabs phyag phreng nas 'jus 'then byas skad rlon pa lo yer gyi tsha bo de red/ gcig ni gro tsha nang so'am/ rdi tsha nang so'i bu yin skad de ni nga tsho zi ling du 'byor skabs gshegs tshar 'dug par brten ngo bzhugs gnyis la nang don gzigs zhib gnang ched dgun thog der glo bur gsang stabs kyis ke'u tshang rin po che nas g.yog wa'i pags tshag bzhes te 7gong sa sku gong ma'i phyag phreng mgul du bzhes/ rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang 'go 'khrid yin tshul gyon chas gzab pa/ skad 'gyur san khron pa skal bzang dang / ke'u tshang dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bcas shar tsong ri kho da mjal mi yin lugs kyi phyi bya stag 'tsher 'khrungs khyim du gnas tshang g.yar te rtse drung blo tshe gzim chung

30sbug dang / ke'u tshang rin po che zhabs gras gzhan gnyis dang mnyam du mdor bzhugs skabs chung srid rin po che nas ke'u tshang rin po che'i 'gram du phebs nas dgyes nyams kyis bzhugs pa dang / sku gong ma'i phyag phreng mngon med mgul du bzhes yod par phyag 'chang gis 'di nga la dgos zhes gsungs par nga su yin ngo shes na spras chog zhu gnang gi lan du se ra'i a ka red ces dang / ma ṇi ma ṇi gsungs/ sbug tu yod pa de su red zhu gnang la rtse drung blo bzang / skad 'gyur der skal bzang / ke'u tshang dge slong tshul rgyal la se ra'i a ka sogs the tshom lnga nor phra mo tsam med par gsungs/ khong rnams de nub de gar bzhugs zhag gnang ste mdzad spyod gang sar zhib brtag gnang skabs ke'u tshang rin po che rang gi mdun du bcar bzhugs dgyes nyams dang / sku gong ma'i phyag phreng la yang yang gzigs zhib 'ju bzung gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar yid ches chen po byung 'dug pa dang /sang zhog khong rnams phebs thon gnang skabs chung srid rin po che gzim rma la nang nas lhan phebs gnang rtsis kyis bsdo/ma pa sogs 'bral mi thub pa lta bu byung 'dug

31ke'u tshang rin po che sogs phyi bya la phebs nyin der nga rang dang / nag chu mkhan po rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin gnyis nas 7gong sa sku gong ma'i phyag phreng gcig zhus 'khyer gyis rlon pa lo yer gyi tsha bo'i khyim der bskyod pa snga dro slebs 'byor la gnas tshang g.yar grogs zhes ja bskol gyis ltod bsdad khyim 'dir khye'u mtshan ltas bzang ba 'dra yod med dris par skyes ma nas paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag phreng nas 'ju mi ngo mtshar che ba yod lugs kyis chung srid la na bza' gsar brjes kyis ngang tsam nas gdan drangs byung ba nged tshor 'tsher snang gi rnam pa kho na ma gtogs bzang ngan gang yang ma byung zhing / sku gong ma'i phyag phreng gzigs na khyad par 'dra yong res phyag phreng skuspyozhabs mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin gyi phyag gi mgor dkris nas 'dir phebs zhes dngos su spyan bstar zhus pa dang khyad med gnang song rung gong bzhin 'tsher snang kho na ma gtogs gzigs zhib dgyes nyams sogs ngo mtshar yid ches kyi rnam pa gang yang ma byung /de nas paṇa chen rin po ches mtshan shog gnang ba'i khyi'u gong khag gnyis dang / gsar du tshol rnyed byung ba bcu gnyis kyi pha ma sogs

32kyi ming dang brjod babs bcas pa'i lo rgyus zhib cha dang sbrags da cha khyi'u rnams la sku gong ma'i sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra dngos su bstan te brtag dpyad zhu 'gabs che min sku/gas 7rgyal khab tu gsang tar 'bul gnang la bdun phrag gsum bzhi'i mtshams bka' lan phyir 'khor du/phyi bya stag 'tsher gyi khyi'u'i mdzad tshul ngo mtshar re 'dun che ba dang bcas snga rjes tshang mar sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra'i brtag dpyad zab nan dgos rgyu'i tar lan phebs/nyin shas nas ke'u tshang rin po ches gtsos nga tsho ngo las rnams glo bur gsang stabs kyis phyi bya stag 'tsher 'khrungs khyim du snga thon skabs sku 'bum dgon pa'i tshogs dung btang ba dang dus 'grigs shing / lam bar zho dang / 'o ma/ chu snod chab kyis bkang ste 'khyer ba bcas rim par thug 'phrad sogs lam bkra legs pa ma sgrig lhun 'grub byung / 'khrungs khyim du slebs nye'i la rtse der nga tsho 'gyor ba dang dus mnyam du la steng de nas mar bong bu me shing bkal ba gsum 'ded pa'i rgya mi dar bzhon zhig yong ba dang thug cing / des de nas mar 'gro lam steng 'og khag gnyis 'dug par 'og ma de nas phebs

33na legs tshul zer ba ltar phebs pas 'khrungs khyim gyi mdun thad de sngon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po shar tsong ri khrod du gnas gzigs su chibs 'gyur skabs chibs bshol sku ngal mdzad de 'khrungs khyim la zhib par gzigs nas 'di snying rje po 'dug ces bka' gnang ba red zer ba'i sa yul der slebs skabs lo der dpyid kyi dpal yon mgron du 'gugs pa'i khu byug gi mgrin glu lnga ga ma de rna bar sems/ shing 'khyer rgya mis bstan pa'i lam 'og ma nas 'khrungs khyim gyi mdun phyogs gzhung sgo lte bar slebs shing / lam gong ma nas bskyod na lam thag nye yang 'khrungs khyim gyi rgyab khyedags ltag sgor slebs pa bcas la rtser don med slo bur du 'phrad pa'i rgya mi de yang dkar phyogs kyi lha srung dag gis lam ston mdzad par sems/ dgong ja khar 'khrungs khyim du 'byor bar nye 'khor sa zhing dang / g.yas g.yon ri dang nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa'i thang chung zhig gi dbus su gzim khang gru bzhi thog gcig ma dkyil du rdo gcal dang de'i dbus dar chen ring po btsugs pa/ khang thog rdo g.yam dang /kha bad g.yu rtsi sngon po sogs mtsho gzigs shog lher gsal ba'i khang

34chung 'di rang red snyam pa'i nged pa lam rnyed byung zhing / de skabs yab chen chu 'thag tu phebs te bzhugs mi 'dug kyang / ༷/ma nas gnas mal g.yar 455 gyis ja 'dren dang / a masngarware ko ril sogs stsal/ chung srid rin po che dgung lo gnyis pa byis pa'i cha byad stod thung smad thung sbrel ma de gras shig bzhes te bzhugs 'dug pas dgyes pa'i nyams mdangs tsam las/ col chung byis pa'i snang tshul ches cher mi mdzad pa'i sgam tshugs che nges mdzad de bzhugs kyi 'dugang tsho bza' 'thung zin mtshams chung srid rin po cher brtag dpyad cig zhus chog pa gsungs te gzim chung nang yul lugs sa khri lta bu 'og tu me gtong yul yod pa'i bsro khang gdengs cha zhig yong ba de'i dkyil du cog rtse ring po'i steng 7gong sa sku gong ma'i sku'i nyer chas ngo ma rnams dang / 'dra ya re re bcas bstar bsgrigs kyis bzhagagayas phyogs su ke'u tshang rin po che dang / de'i 'gram nag chu mkhan po rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ g.yon phyogs su nged rang dang /de'i 'gram rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang bcas bsdad de chung srid rin po che gdan zhus kyis 7gong sa sku gong ma'i phyag phreng nag po ngo 'dra

35gnyis ke'u tshang rin po che'i phyag tu bzhes ce gang dgos bka' 'dri zhu gnang la the tshom med par ngo ma de rang 'phrog stabs kyis bzhes te mgul du bzhes song / de rjes phyag phreng ser po ngo 'dra gnyis spyan bstar gnang ba'ang gong bzhin mgul du bzhes/ sba'i phyag mkhar ngo 'dra gnyis spyan bstar skabs 'dra de yar tsam 'then pa gnang song bas phyag phreng gnyis ngo nor byung ma song yang / phyag mkhar thugs nor gyur song bsam pa'i dngangs skrag tshab tshub kyis blta zhing bsdad par phyag mkhar gnyis ka'i rtsa rtser zhib gzigs kyis 'dra de rang 'jags 'jog gnang gis ngo ma de rang yar bzhes phyag gasku na gyis bzung ste te sar 'dzugs mdzad song / phyag mkhar de gnyis ni rtse bshan kho dang / lcags gnyis kyi khyad tsam ma galta gas gcig pa yin pa dang / 'dra de yang de sngon 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum chen pos phyag bzhes kyis sgrub khang sku gong mar 355 zhing / sgrub khang bo nga mas ke'u tshang rin po cher 'bul gnang mdzad pa zhig yin gshis dang po 'dra de bzhes pa'i rgyu mtshan yang sngar gyi byung tshul mkhyen pa'i brda ston gnang ba yin 'dug sku'i nye chas sne gsum ngo nor med par ngos

36'dzin gnang ba'i dga' ba dang / da dung sne gcig ngos 'dzin gnang rgyur bsdad pa'i ngo ma de ni gsung brda gnang byed ba so'i rnga chung lta bur yu ba sprad pa zhig dang / 'dra de ba so'i ḍa ma ru gser gyi sked bcings khra ldan ḍa ma mdzar gos chen cho sa tshogs me tog ris stong chob sogs snying rje po yod par brten 'dra de bzhes mi yong ngam snyam pa'i blo g.yengs dga' gdung mnyam 'gran ngang ngo 'dra gnyis spyan bstar gnang skabs the tshom ka kor med par ngo ma rang bzhes te phyag g.yas pa sa bkrol brdungs gnang bzhin par dgyes nyams bzhad mo dang bcas nga chos tshang mar re re bzhin zhib gzigs gnang 'dug pa kog 'gyur mngon gzigs kyi mdzad 'phrul ngo ma tshar rmad du byung bar ha las yid ches dga' dad skyo gsum mnyam 'gran lta bus tshang ma'i mig gnyis mchi mas khengs shing / dbugs tshangs gdan steng mi tshugs pa lta bus smra brjod gang yang ma thub par gcig gis gcig la gyu sug dang / pus mo ra mnan brdungs byas te bar chad nyes skyon ma 'byung ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam btab te sdod rgyu red/ ngang rtsam nas sku'i nyer chas rnams phyir stsal zhus shing / de rjes yab chen

pon7yang chu 'thag nas phebs byung bas sngo sa mjal gyi de nub lhod bzhugs thog de sngon mtshan ltas ngo mtshar che ba ji byung dngos brgyud nyang rtsad skabs yab yum gnyis nas de 'dra gang yang ma byung zhes gsung gi 'dug kyang / yul mi gzhan dag nas brjod rigs su/ bla ma rtsa che'i 'khrungs ltas su yul der dka' ngal yong lugs brjod srol ltar khong tsho'i lung par lo bzhi'i ring ston nyes dang / 'khrungs khang gi sgo zog mnangs che mang po rim pas 'chi god/ yab chen yun ring bsnyun mnar 'di phyir thug pa chung srid rin po che 'khrungs nyid rang bzhin gyis sing dwangs byung ba/ 'khrungs nyin khyim der 'ja' zug pa sogs ji snyed brjod rgyu 'dug nga tsho de nub mtshan sgang ring de nyin gyi mdzad tshul rnams yid ngor lhang lhang 'char te gnyid khug pa'i go skabs nam yang ma byung / sang nyin sku 'bum du phyir log bya khar chung srid rin po che yang lhan phebs gnang rtsis kyis rjes 'phreng mdzad par yab yum sogs nas dbu bskor mdzad cing phran chod yang mnyam por gdan zhu bya rgyu byung na snyam pas phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa lta bu byung yang / skabs der yid 'phreng phyi mig blta bzhin 'gro

38rgyu las gzhan bya thabs gang yang ma mchis/nyin gnyis gsum rjes rlon pa lo yer gyi tsha bo de bzhin sku 'bum dbo na du lo yer gyi shag tu phebs 'dug gshis nga tsho brtag dpyad zhu bar bcar chog pa zhes sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra rnams bsnams te lo yer gyi shag tu ched phebs thog shag de'i dkar phibs 'og tu cog rtse ring po'i steng sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra rnams bstar bsgrigs kyis khyi'u chung gdan zhus sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra spyan bstar thabs shes rnam pa ci drag gang la'ang phyag 'chang ba tsam gnang rigs byung ma song /chung srid de bzhin sku 'bum khri chen ke kya'i sprul sku yin 'dug pa rjes sor ngos 'dzin mdzad de sku 'bum dgon du gsan bsam mdzad mus gyi btsan 'og tu tshud pa red/de mjug kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches shog lhe gnang gsal chung srid ngo bzhugs gnyis la sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra'i brtag dpyad zhus pa'i byung tshul dang / gsar rnyed khag la rim pas brtag dpyad zhu rgyur bo nga gi byung tshul rnams gsang rgya gang che mdzad 'os snyam pa'i skor/ gsang tar dang / rta shad gdong snyan zhu zhib cha 'bul

39gnang mdzad pa'i bka' lan ma 'khod par zla ba mang po 'gor zhing /gsar rnyed 'os sprul gzhan khag la brtag dpyad gnang phyogs ji 'gabs dgongs bzhes gnang mus su rgyal khab nas bka' tar phebs pa'i dgongs don du phyi bya stag 'tsher gyi chung srid rin po che'i snga phyi'i mdzad tshul ngo mtshar che ba dang / 'khrungs khang sa gnas sogs rgyal tshab rin po che'i mtsho gzigs byung ba dang mthun nges/ slar yang bla lha khag gi thugs dam bka' lung sogs tshang ma rtse mthun gyis da cha 7rgyal ba'i yang srid ngo ma phyi bya stag 'tsher tshang du yab chos skyong tshe ring dang / yum bsod nams mtsho mo gnyis la shing phag rgya zla 6tshes nyi shar 'brug thog sku bltams pa'i khye'u lha mo don 'grub la thugs gtan gtsang 'khel zin pas 'phral du gdan zhu thub thabs dgos rgyu zhes phebs byung yang / 7rgyal ba'i yang srid thugs gtan 'khel ba'i gnas lugs phyi grags byung tshe zi ling rmā kru'u zhis bod la dbang bsgyur bya rgyu'i go skabs 'tshol gzhi sogs ji byed nges med dang / de min na'ang za brngams ka kor che ba bya rgyu yin pa dngos mthong la brten de 'phral ke'u tshang rin po cher nor gling gzim chung nas

40bskur bzhes mdzad pa'i dpal ldan lha mo'i sku thang yod pa'i mdun du 'phrin bcol dang 'brel bas 7rgyal ba'i yang srid thugs gtan 'khel skor phyi nang su la'ang tshig zur tsam brjod thal mi 'byung ba byed rgyu'i nga tsho ngos las bzhi nas mna' 'dam rgyas dpyad thog rgyal khab la'ang yang srid thugs gtan khel ba'i gnas lugs phyir grags byung tshe shar gtong byed re bral bas 'di gar ngo las mna' dam byas lugs dang bcas rgyal khab nas kyang gnas skabs gsang rgya gang che mdzad gal che nges dang / 'di gar dogs gzhi mi 'byung ched khye'u gzhan dag khag la brtag dpyad zhu bar sa gnas so sku ra ngo bskyod bya rgyu lam 'gor che ba ma zad/ brtag dpyad zhu lugs dang / sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra gang dang ci sku da sogs gcig nas gnyis brgyud kyis shes rtogs sku ngas grags lta bur gyur na 'grigs min la brten/ tshang ma sku 'bum du bsdu bskongs yong thabs kru'u zhir zhu bskul gyis brtag dpyad zhu tshul byas zin pa'i rjes su stag 'tsher chung srid rin po che 'os sprul khongs su bod la gdan zhu byas 'thus zi ling kru'u zhir rgyal khab rang nas bka' tar dang sbrags 'di nas zhu bskul byas na 'gabs

41min sogs kyi gsang tar zhib cha 'bul gnang mdzad/rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i mtsho gzigs shog lhe'i nang dgon pa thodag sa gsum brtsegs bar thog g.yu rtsi can gyi yang steng gser zangs kyi rgya phibs sku da pa ni zi ling khul gyi dgon pa che shos sku 'bum dgon pa dasngo sa ra gsal 'a'o/da yin pa dang / de nas shar dre gas phyi bya stag 'tsher 'khrungs khyim phyogs 'gro lam thal ler yod pa / ri chung gi rtsa bar stag 'tsher 'khrungs khyim la kha bad g.yu rtsi g.yam thog sngon ngo byas pa bcas mthodang ba tsam gyis rim bzhin lnga 'phrod yid ches byung ba dang / dbu can gyi yi ge ‘‘a ’’ni a mdo zhes yul ming / 66ka ’’ni don gnyis su 'jug pa dang po khul de'i dgon pa che rtsodas sku 'bum zhes pa'i ming gzhi ka dang / gnyis pa 'khrungs khang yod pa'i grong gseb de'i ri steng karma shar tsong ri khrod ces karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i dgon pa yod pa'i ming gzhi dang po/ ma ni karma shar comang ri khrod kyi ming gzhi gnyis pa bcas gsal brjen du bstan sku1da pa yin no//

42sna tshogs 'phrul gyis skye srid bzung ba'i khrod//brtag pa'i srang la lci ba'i nor gyi bu//ga zi 'ode tsāb 'bar nyi khyim grangs 'dzin pas//brtan g.yo'i shis pa sgrub la rings par 'jug/khyod sku na lhan po'i kho lag gtos che bas /sku na tan mchog gzhan yung 'bru'i gnas sbyin phyir//cad mtshar lo 'dab ༷ la ba 'ga' mchis kyang //skyes mchog pad dkar sdong bu gcig pur 'khums//dmo pa'i gshis su sgyu gas pa'i ngang tshul gtam//brjad la rgyal sras rnams kyang zhum gyur na//byis pa'i gtam 'dis rgya che'i bkod pa stong //mtshon par mi nus rang skal tsam du sdud//

43 le'u lnga pa/zi ling rmā kru'u zhi'i dka' rnyogs/nga tsho ngo las bzhi sku 'bum dgon nas zi ling du phebs te rmā kru'u zhir 7rgyal ba'i 'os sprul khye'u mtshan rtags bzang khongs nas thag nye khag gnyis la brtag dpyad zhus zin pa dang / de byings mtshan tho nang gsal rnams la brtag dpyad zhu bar sa gnas so sor rim bskyod bya rgyu yun 'gor phyir grags yong nyen sogs kyi skyon cha gong gsal zhib gsol gyis khye'u tshang ma sku 'bum dgon du ched 'gugs gdan zhu yong ba zhu gnang la sku 'bum du 'gabs min zi ling rang du bskongs 'thus dang / 'byor mtshams brtag dpyad ji dgos khyed tsho rang nas bya dgos zer ba nga tsho phyi tshul tsam las nang don gtan 'khel zin par brten phyi tshul ji byas khyad par med gshis chung srid rnams zi ling du 'dzoms dus tshes cha gtan 'khe' gyis sku 'bum du phyir phebs/

44gong gi dus tshes thog zi ling du phebs te khye'u rnams tshang 'dzoms byung min dang / brtag dpyad zhu yul sa gnas sogs phrin min hru'u krang brgyud bka' mol gnang bar tshang ma 'dreger song don khye'u mang 'dzom/sa dgos gshis brtag dpyad sa gnas srid gzhung las khungs su bya dgos dang / bya lugs ji dgos sogs chos kyi bya bar brten nga tshos byus the gang yang med par khyed tsho rang nas byas 'thus zer ba bzhin/ gnang nyin sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra sogs 'khyer te sing drin pu'u du phebs par brtag dpyad bya rgyu'i yo byad rnams ngo mtshar che ba yong rgyur brten/ kru'i zhir mig ston yong ba zer don yul dpon btsan dbang che bas don med mkhregs bzung bya rgyu dge mtshan bral gshis phran tsho tshang 'dzoms med par kha dbye chog min zhes kru'u zhi'i sar ngo las bzhi mnyam bskyod kyis sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra rnams mig ston mdzad/ slar yang sngar gtam rjes 'gyur gyis brtag dpyad bya lugs la nga tshos byus the mi byed kyang 'di rigs sngon chad mthong thos rtsa ba nas med gshis da res nga tsho mi 'ga' shas nas mig blta chodag pa zhes kru'u zhi rang dang spun mched dpon rigs mi lnga mnyam 'byor

45zur ngos nas gzigs shing / dkyil du sgrog rtse ring po'i steng sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra rnams bstar bsgrigs kyis chung srid so so'i pha ma spun mched gang 'os re dang sbrags rim pas re re bzhin gdan zhus kyis spyan bstar dang / gzhan yang kru'u zhi sogs mgo bo rmongs ched ke'u tshang rin po che nas chung srid so so'i snyan dang / ljags kyi rtsa ris sogs la zhib gzigs dang / phran dang sku zhabs mkhyen bstan gnyis nas bzang lan rnams tho 'god bya khul zhus/ chung srid pha ma so sor mjal dar re dang / snam spyan spus legs bub re bcas 'bul gnang gis gnas skabs rang khungs so sor phyir phebs mdzad 'os zhu gnang mdzad/ chung srid rnams nas sku'i nyer chas ngos 'dzin skor khye'u bcu gnyis yod pa 'ga' shas nas ngo 'dra phyed 'khyer dang /de byings phal cher nas ngo ma gcig dang 'dra gsum/ 'ga' shas nas 'dra sha stag re zung nas 'jigs 'tsher lta bus ngo 'dra gang la'ang reg thug ma mdzad pa sku gas sna tshogs shig las/ yid ched ngo mtshar rgyu mtshan brjod 'os yod pa gcig kyang byung ma song zhing / zi ling rmu kru'u zhis brtag dpyad snga rjes byas khongs nas nges pa rnyed pa byung min

46dang / re 'dun chen po su yod sogs bka' 'dri zhu bar nga tshor gnas tshul ji byung rgyal khab tu snyan dar 'bul rgyu dang / rgyal khab nas sa gnas gzha—na dag khag gi 'os sprul rnams dang bcas bla lhar lung brtag gneng rgyu ma galta gas nga choras bzang ngan gang yang chongad dpag shan 'byed zhu stangs shes min la bka' lan 'khor mtshams 'di khongs nas re che'i dmigs yul byung tshe bod du gdan zhu bya 'os yod dam/yang bskyar 'acesal zhib zhu dgos min sogs rgyal khab kyi bka' lan 'khor bstun rim par zhus chog pa zhes zhu gnang gis sku 'bum dgon du phyir log rgyal khab tu gong gsal byung tshul snyan tar zhib 'bul gnang /de bar zi ling kru'u zhis stag 'tsher rlon pa sogs chung srid 'ga' shas lan gnyis su gdan zhus kyis shing tog mngar cha phul nas dri ba zhus pa ra stag 'tsher chung srid rin po che'i mdzad tshul la blo mos che byung gis sku 'bum dgon du gdan zhu gnang dgos brjod yod 'dugargyal khab kyi bka' lan du yang srid nges gtan khel skor de gar gsang rgya bya rgyu'i mna' dam bzhag pa sogs 'thus legs byung 'dug cing /

47'dir yang de don gsang rgya nges par bya rgyu ma zad/ 7rgyal ba'i yang srid thad 'di phyogs nas re ba yod pa gnyis dang / der yod stag 'tsher chung srid lha mo don 'grub bcas rgyal khab tu gdan 'dzoms bla lhar lung brtag rtsis gsum gyi thog nas gtan 'khel gnang rgyu yin lugs sogs bathe da chu gas ji 'os sngar bzhin zab gsal myur gsum 'dzoms pa'i sgo nas don snying 'phral du gdan zhu thub thabs dgos rgyu'i bka' tar dang / bang mi'i gdong bka' rgya bcas rim par 'gyor/phyi bya stag 'tsher 'khrungs khang 'di bzhin da lta'i stag 'tsher rin po che 'dis mtshon stag 'tsher sku thog gnyis 'khrungs pa dang /stag 'tsher sgar pa'i lo yer yang yab chos skyong tshe ring mchog gi sku mched bgres pa bcas la brten stag 'tsher lo yer la chung srid lha mo don 'grub mchog 7rgyal ba'i codas sprul khongs thugs gtan 'khel gshis sku 'bum rang du gdan 'dren thugs nyar gyis gtsang sbra gang che yong ba dang / zi ling rmā kru'u zhir bka' mol zhus te ring min bod du gdan zhu bya rgyur de lugs mdzad phyogs dgongs bzhes yong

48ba'i nang mo la gnang / nga tsho ngo las zi ling du phebs te phrin mi hru'u krang brgyud rgyal khab kyi bka' dgongs dang mthun pa'i rgyal ba'i 'os sprul khongs phyi bya stag 'tsher gyi khye'u lha mo ro/na 'grub yab yum dang bcas bod du 'phral myur gdan zhu chodag pa zhu gnang la skabs 'phral lan gsal gang yang ma byung zhing / nyin shas sku nga mtshams sngon du khye'u mang po yod khongs nas lha mo don 'grub rkyang pa bod du 'khrid don gang yin sogs dogs 'dri mang po byas byung bar khye'u mang po yod pa'i khongs nas lha mo don 'grub mtsho gzigs shog lhe dang lam tsam mthun pa byung tshod dang / de dang 'dra ba bod du yang re ba che nges gnyis yod lugs sku gas khong snu'i brjod babs dang bstun pa'i skabs 'phral thal lus med pa'i lan 'debs mdzad/ de rjes bskyar ma'i bskul lcag gnang mthar 'phral du gdarme/ zhu nges par dgos tshe sring dring phu'u zhes sa gnas srid gzhung dang / cun drin pu'u zhes dmag srid las khungs/sku 'bum bla spyi bcas spyir rda yang stong phrag brgya tham pa 'bul sprod byung na btang 'thus zer bar dngul 'bor de tsam phul chog med gzhis rgyal khab tu tar phul chodag pa zhes gsungs te sku 'bum dgon

49du phyir phebs kyis kru'u zhir sprod dngul dang / lag sne kha snon 'phral stsol yong ba'i rgyal khab tu tar 'bul gnang zhing /stag 'tsher lo yer la kru'u zhi'i brjod babs nang gsal dang bcas ke'u tshang rin po che nas ched sgrub mdzad pa'i sku'i tshe rdzas gsang stabs kyis 'bul gnang mdzad/ dgun thog de rang bod du chibs sgyur thub res mtsho sngon sog po'i dpon khag la rnga bong bdal khungs dang / rnga bong steng snagel bzhugs gnang rgyu'i gzim sgrom sogs 'du 'god 'og grabs sa/nang / bar der zi ling khul gyi mi ser yongs rdzogs lo grangs rgyas dpyad kyis snga rting rim bkug dmag rtsed slob sbyong byed pa'i khongs stag 'tsher yab chen yang phebs dgos bskul brda byung song ba ring min bod du gdan zhu dgos gshis dbu skra gcod 'breg dang / dmag sbyong khongs phebs ma/ dgos pa zhes kru'u zhi rang dang / phrin mi hru'u krang so sor 'bul rten gos chen dar babs dang /bskyin khebs/ snam phrug thig ris dang bcas zhu phebs la ka kor mang tsam gyis mtha' ma dgongs yang btang tsam byung / 'gyangs cher ma song bar rgyal khab nas dngul brjes 'gyor 'phral zi ling du ched

50phebs thog rmā kru'u zhi 'gyur ldog dran 'phrul che ba'i nyer len sogs gang ltar phrin mi tru'u krang yang kha dag tshig gnad ches cher mi 'dug gshis 'gyur ldog mi 'byung ba'i bar dpang yong res de sngon chu sprel lo bod rgya dmag 'khrugs skabs stod smad phyogs rub byas te ldan khog nas kha dang gra bzhi rgya sbyong dmag sgar gyi gnyis pa'i ru dpon 'gyur med tshe brtan dang / cha dang gzim pa me sgrogs dmag sgar gyi ru dpon slo bzang yon tan sogs bzung 'khrid byed po kru'u zhi'i a khu'i gras zi rgan ma zer ba do bdag ngo ma nged tsho zi ling du phebs skabs ri rgya dmag 'khrug yod rkyen zi ling dpung dmag gi spyi khyab tu bskyod de bsdad mi 'dug kyang / de'i bza' zlar skye mdo smad shod tshang gi bu mo zhig sngon nas zi ling du 'khrid pa de bzhin bsdad 'dug pa de dag bod kyi lar zhen chos la dad mo sa che zhing / bza' zla'i babs kyis zi khul cha mchodang che tsam 'dug gshis skad sgyur zhu brgyud chab bsgrags su 'khrid de phrin mi tru'u krang la da cha dngul 'byor byung ba rtsis bzhes kyis 'di lo dgun thos/ rang 'phral thon thub pa'i rogs ram yong ba zhes zhu gnang la dngul rnams rmā rdal rdal brgyud rtsis 'bul dgos

51rgyur kru'u zhir snyan seng dang 'brel dngul rnams khungs so sor sprang/ cide lan gsal byas 'thus zer bar nyin mang bsgugs kyang nges gsal gang yang ma byung bas rmā rda‘smu rdal dang phrin rang ngo 'phrad skabs su gang babs kyi bskul lcag rim par byas mthar nyin gcig kru'u zhi rang nas bkag 'gog med par shar gtong bya rtsis kyang / sku 'bum dgon pas 7rgyal ba'i yang srid yin tshe sku 'bum sogs dgon pa che chung dang /bod sogs dad can khag la dril bsgrags mjal kha dgos tshul zhu bsun che gshis khyed tsho sku 'bum tshogs/ 'du dang go bsdur bya gal che lugs zer ba ltar sku 'bum du phyir phebs/ tshogs 'du nam tshugs 'on seng dang 'brel ngo las tshang ma tshogs 'du lhan rgyas sar bcar skabs so/nga du kru'u zhime gang gsungs ltar rgyal ba'i mtshan gsol mjal kha ma zhus par gtong thabs med lugs ka kor ji mang dang /tshogs 'du ba na gzhon 'ga' shas thugs rgyal cher bzhengs kyis phran tshor ha lam brdung bdeg gnang nyen yang 'dug par bod ljongs chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid kyi rtsa bar brten 'os sprul rnams rgyal khab rang du gdan 'dzoms bla

52lha'i lung dang / zan brtag sogs sgo kun nas bsreg bcad brdar gsum gyi go bsdur zab nan mdzad de thugs gtan sur 'khel de nyid lam seng pho brang yas mas gang 'os su gdan zhu bdag sprod mdzad rgyu ma gtogs thag ring phan tshun nas gtan khel mdzad thabs med pa'i gnas lugs zhib rgyas dang / 'os sprul khongs nas 7rgyal ba'i yang srid thugs gtan ma khel ba rnams kyang rang bzhin bdag med du ma song bar skyes chen dam par ngos 'dzin gyis yab yum sku mched dang bcas par rten gnas dang 'brel ba'i mtshan don gnyis tshang yong nges las/ rang bzhin bdag med du 'jog srol med pa'i lo rgyus/ dad 'dun mjal kha zhu gnang mdzad 'dod yod tshe mtshan gsol zhus min la ma ltos par 'os sprul rang la mjal kha zhu gnang mdzad par 'gal ba med lugs sogs zhi 'jam gus btud thabs mkhas kyis tshogs 'du snga rjes gang sar dge skyo na go games ji ltar zhus kyang 7rgyal ba'i yang srid nges gtan med par rang bzhin 'os sprul zhes don med a mdo'i phru gu bod du 'khrid rgyu dge mtshan med lugs ka kor brjod rnyogs kho na ma gtogs dgongs bzhes gnang rigs ma byung / sku

53'bum khongs nang nye khag nas sku 'bum tshogs 'dur kru'u zhis bkod byus gang btang las bya thabs med gshis kru'u zhi rang la zhu gal che lugs zer don sku 'bum tshogs 'du lhan rgyas la da lam bka' mo la zhus pa'i gnas lugs dang bcas slar yang kru'u zhi'i sku 'dun ched bcar zhib zhu bya rgyur tshogs 'du lhan rgyas nas kyang 'os sprul bod phyogs 'phral du gdan zhu thub thabs skor char pa chu skrasags yong ba zhes zhu gnang gis zi ling du phebs te phrin mi hru'u krang dang / rmā rdal rdal/gzhan yang gnad sku da don phan yong re khag la zhu bskul rgyu 'gros thabs shes dang / rgyal khab nas drung chin don gce da brgyud rgya nag sazhung la zhu bskul sogs thabs shes rim par mdzad rung nges gsal gang med par yu na ring 'gor/snga rjes gang sar ke'u tshang rin po ches dbus phran tsho ngo las sger so so/'i sar dpon rigs sogs ngo shes khag nas nang gtam yin lugs kyis 7rgyal ba'i yang srid nges gtan dril bsgrags byas tshe zi bod mthun lam gong 'phel dang / khyed tsho spyi sger gang sar rgya bod gnyis phyogs nas byas rjes ngo so gzengs thon che zhing / 'phral yun

54kun tu drin 'jags 'jog bzo bin tu che ba yongs lugs sogs tshod bgam ngan bslus byed po snga phyi rim par byung yang / dngos shugs gang sar don skyon tshig thal sne btags tsam med/ de rjes slar yang kru'u zhir zhabs bskul rim nan zhus par 7rgyal ba'i yang srid nges gtan med par gdan zhu ma byas thu med yin tshe rang bzhin lam rkyang gtong rgyu sku 'bum sogs dgon pa che chung khag nga/nga / bod sog nang pa'i chos la dad can rnams blo pham gleng lan che ba yong dang yong rgyur de dag 'gog ched slar yang rda yang stong phrag sum brgya tham pa dang /sku 'bum dgon du 7rgyal ba sku gong ma'i na bza' khri chas cha tshang /gser bris kyi bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur cha tshang re bcas 'bul sprod byung na gdan zhu byas mthus zer ba ya rabs kyi khrims dang las 'bras lnga khrel yongs su bral ba'i brjod babs la ha las hon thor gyis dar cig ci brjod bral zhing / zhib tu bsam skabs bod ljongs bstan srid/ skye 'gro'i srog shing gcig pu'i rtsa don gal cher brten mes 'tsheg mer gtugs bya rgyu khe na las ma 'das gshis dngul 'bab khyon che sngon phul zin pa de gas 'thus pa dang / 7rgyal mchog sku gong ma'i

55na bza' khri chas/ gser bris kyi bka' bstan bcas bod du 'bror 'phral nges 'bul chog pa'i bka' mol thabs shes ci zab rim par gnang yang dngul 'bab rnams 'phral du ma byung bar gtong shes bral lugs rang 'dod nyag rkyang la brten rgyal khab tu dgongs bskor zhus te bka' lan dang bstun rim bcar chog pa zhes sku 'bum dgon du phyir phebs thog kru'u zhis sngar gtam rjes 'gyur gyi brjod babs rnams snyan tar 'bul gnang la bdun phrag gnyis gsum rjes dngul brjes gang myur gnang rgyu'i bka' lan 'gyor byung yang / zi ling kru'u zhi rmā sbu phang zhes pa rang bzhin gyis 'e/ sdang zhing / bya ba gang yang 'brel med byung rgyal du spyod pa/ ngan 'khrul bya spyod la shin tu goms pa phra men gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin bsam brjod las 'das pa dper mtshon na/ sku 'bum gser khri ho thog thu zhes pa de sngon lcags lug lo nang bar rgya nag tu bzhugs te rgya dpon cang kru'u zhi dang 'brel zab che zhing / cang gis mtshan gnas tham kha sogs kyi gzengs bstod dang / phyi nang bka' mngags zhib zhus kyi sku 'bum dgon du phyir phebs gnang skabs lam bar a lag sha dang tse/ra thusu'i

56sa mtshams tin kherware zhes pa'i rgya grong der zhag bzhugs sar kha che mi ser dkyus ma'i chas gyon jag dmag brgya lha ra zhig nas bzhugs yul mtha' bskor/ 'ga' shas nang du 'dzul te gser khri rin po cher mi 'phen gyis bkrongs rjes dngos po gang yang ma 'khyer bar gar song cha med du phyin pa dang / rim pas sku gdung zi ling du 'gyor mtshams phyi tshul bcos ma'i 'dra chags ched rgya mi'i yul srol mya ngan byas te che bstod dar 'phan gyis sne drangs dmag mis sku 'bum dgon du gdan zhu byas pa bcas don snying gser khri ho thog thu zi ling du phebs mtshams kru'u zhi'i dbang byus la gnod rkyen byed lam mi bde ba byung dogs kru'u zhi pha bu'i ngan 'khrul dmag mi lkog gtong byas pa khul der yongs grags thog phran tsho zi ling khul 'byor rjes kyang bar skabs shig la rgya gzhung nas rmā sbu phang dmag spyi'i go ming rang 'jags dang / kru'u zhi ngo ma rmā sbu phang gi skyed byed kyi spun zhig la bskos te las 'khur rtsis len zin lugs zer gshis nga tsho ngo las rnams 'bul rten sha rwa gla rtsi dang / snam spos/ gos chen zar babs bskyin khebs sogs bsnams te zi ling du ched phebs 'u'i 'i h+phu'u krang

57zer ba brgyud snyan gseng zhu dgos 'dug pa ltar zhus te mjal 'phrang/ byung ba mi rgan bag gro zhig 'dug pas zi bod mthun lar dge ba'i rogs ram gang yod zhu rgyu zer/ de rjes tsam nas phyogs mtha'i dgon pa ri khrod dang / yul 'brog khag la rkun jag gis mi bsad rgyu 'phrog sogs sdod bzod bde min ji snyed byung ba'i skad grags chen po 'dug pa kru'u zhi gsar pas khrims 'go non min gleng lhag 'byung ched rmā sbu phang nas dmag mir ngan bslab lkog gtong byas lugs zer zhing /nyin gcig gnam gru zhig sku 'bum la'ang lding bskor dang bcas zi ling du babs pa'i nang go ming tang gi dmag spyi hu'u hu'u rbad khrun shi zer ba de yod 'dug par rmā sbu phang nas dri bzang kha che sha kha ma'i snod lcags sprin glang chen lam spar can de gras gsum gser gyis bkang ba lkog brngan gyis kru'u zhi rang 'jags yong thabs zhus skad smeng grags byung song ba dngos bden yin min gang ltar zla ba gnyis gsum lhag ma sro/nga bar slar yang rmā sbu phang la kru'u zhi rang 'jags bskos te rgan po blo pham ngang mtshan gung rang yul du log skad kyis rmā sbu phang la dbang byus rang 'jags byung song ba sku/gas g.yo thabs ngan 'khrul

58che khar/ sku 'bum bla gra'i khongs sogs gzhung ltos nang ma khag nas khyed tsho 7rgyal ba'i yang srid slor gyi don gnad gal che 'di dag la kru'u zhi'i ngan spyod ji yod nges pa med gshis bag phebs/ su 'dug mi rigs pas sbi sangs stabs gzab byed gal che lugs gsung mi snga phyir byung ba phran tshor kho pas ji byas chog rung / yang srid thugs gtan khel slor shes rtogs byung na gang min bya rgyur brten/ tar deb sogs yig khag gal che 1ri ma rnams rtag tu thog gseng la sbas te 'dra brdzus gsar baXsgos yig sgam nang nyar tshags thog rang gzhung rgyal khab tu'ang kho par dngul 'bab phran tshos rang bzhin 'phral spros byed rgyu spyang ki rta zos lug ros mi 'grangs pa'i dpe ltar slar yang 'gyur ldog ji byed nges pa med stabs re zhig dngul brjes sa/nang thal mi 'byung ba'i rnyen tar phul zhing / da lta rang kru'u zhi kho pa'i ngan 'khrul bya spyod ji yong snyam pa'i blo g.yeng che nges zas bcud gnyid bral 'jigs ye rer gnas dgos byung yang / mchodag gsum byin mthus glags blta'i nyes skyon gnod 'gal rigs ma byung ba dang /dngul 'bab sprod phyogs ji 'gabs dgongs bzhes gnang

59mur de lo dus skabs stes dbang stabs legs kyis khang phu'u thon krang sogs hu'u hu'u 'byor ldan mang po zhig rgya gar brgyud kha che'i gnas me ka zhes par gnas mjal la 'gro skad thos gshis skabs de'i zi ling sgar dpon rwa sgreng bla brang gi mi 'gro a mdo bya khrung bsam 'grub dang / phran gnyis khang phu'u thon krang sar zi ling du ched bskyod mtshams rtags snam rigs dang bcas gnas mjal du phebs mi lhan thog dngul brjes bya rgyu yod med 'phros mol zhus par dngul 'bor de tsam dngul brjes bya rgyu slar kru'u zhis ka kor 'dra byung na gang min bya rgyur brten/ nga rang gcig pos rang bzhin blos 'gan bzod thabs bral bas gnas mjal 'gro mi tshang ma gros mol bya rgyu zer don dngul 'bab sprad rjes kru'u zhis dngos shugs brgyud gsum du bkag 'gog ka kor mi byung ba hu'u hu'u gnas mjal tshogs spyi rang nas sngon tshud thabs shes 'phros mol zab nan gyis 'gan len bya rgyu dang / sa/nas mjal tshogs spyir khe skyed lta bar skabs der rda yang las da/byin sgor ༄mdza' thang che gshis zi ling du rda yang ji sprad la bod nas dbyin sgor mgo thug gi sprod rgyu'i 'phros mol kha dan lam tsam byas te gzhi rtsa khang tsho

60phu'u hu'u hu'u byings dang / phran gnyis nas ke'u tshang rin po che sogs la bka' mol zhus te gtan khel thag gcod zi ling du byed rgyu'i tshes cha dus bkag bzos te phyir log dus skabs de tsam na kun gzigs par+ṇa chen sku gong ma dben sa pa nas brtsis pa'i sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po mchog bod phebs gnang bzhed kyi sku srung rgya dmag lhan 'khrid gnang na 'grigs min sto/ra thugs gtan ma khel ba'i ngang skye mdor dgung grangs /5thog dgongs pa chos dbyings zhi ba chen por mnal tshul bstan pa'i dgongs rdzogs ma chod sprin dgos skor paṇa chen nang ma khang nas tshe chog gling dang / dngul chu sprul sku gnyis la tar 'byor song ba bzhin phran tsho nas kyang sku 'bum dgon pa sogs/ la mchod sprin spro 'bul mdzad/bo nga gi tshes/ grangs dus bkag thog phran tsho ngo las tshang ma zi ling du khang phu'u thon krang sar ched phebs lhan 'dzoms bka' mol rim gnang gis mtha' don khang phu'u thon krang sku gas gnas mjal tshos/sa pas kru'u zhir zhu bskul zab nan gyi sgo nas rdo don zi ling rmā

61kru'u zhis dalnga sa su ming 'dogs ka tshe ra sna chongags kyis bkag 'gog dang / de min na'ang rkun jag brdzus gtong gis/ mtho 'tshams pa sogs g.yo lhad dran 'khrul dbang gis lam bar 'gag 'gyings nye zho'i bar chad mi 'byung ba'i thabs shes 'phros mol nges gdengs khel ba byas te dngul 'bab rnams hu'u hu'u tshogs spyis kru'u zhir 'bul rgyu dang / de'i tshab rda yang dbyin sgor 'go thug gis nga tshos bod nas dbyin sgor le thogs med par sprod rgyu/ yang kru'u zhis dngos shugs brgyud gsum gang rigs kyi sgo nas bkag 'gog 'gal rkyen rigs srid tshe dngulī 'bab sprod lem/ ma dgos pa/ gser bris kyi bka' bstan dang / 7rgyal mchodag sku gong ma'i na bza' khri chas bcas bod nas rjes galta nga bya rgyu bcas par kha dan gyis phan tshun mnyam 'dzoms sgog nas phrin mi tru'u krang brgyud kru'u zhir gnas lugs zhib zhus dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas chod gan bod rgya bshan 'byar 'dra bzhir ming rtags bkod de rmā kru'u zhi dang / sku 'bum dgon pa/ khang phu'i thon krang / phran tsho ngo las bcas so so nas 'dra re nyar bdag gis chung srid rin po che'i mtshan du 'os sprul zhes gsol te bod du gdan zhu

62bya rgyu'i sgo legs par dod/dngul 'bab sprod len bya rgyu'i skor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen ngo mchodag gi thugs bskyed 'phrin las dang / bstan srung dmar nag gi byin mthus de lo rgya gar brgyud me ka zhes par gnas mjal du 'gro mi kru'u zhi'i gnyen ltos khang phu'u thon krang can 'byor ldan khag mang yod rkyen thal lus med pa'i dngul brjes thabs shes bya rgyu byung zhing de min rgyal khab nas dngul brjes gnang rgyu gzhir bcas kyang / nga tsho ngo las rnams sngar dug sprul nag pos srog bcad da thi gu khra khrar ya nga zer ba'i dpe ltar sngon ma nang bzhin 'gyur ldog 'byung nyen che bas rang bzhin sprod nus bral ba sogs gang sa nas 'os sprul rin po che skabs 'phral gdan zhu thub thabs rtsa ba nas bral ba zhig red/ de nas sku 'bum bla spyi dang / stag 'tsher sgar pa/ yab yum lhan rgyas bcas par bka' mol gyis thodad rgyal 'o/ 2066 phyi lo 1939 dbyar 'grulacadang stabs mtshungs bod du gdan zhu bya gtan 'khel te kru'u zhir gnas lugs zhu gnang skabs sku srung gto/nga dgos

63kyi lam gron rda yang lnga stong dgos rgyu dang / 'os sprul bod phebs ma zin bar khyed tsho mi bzhi nas su rung gcig zi ling du sdod dgos zer skor sogs rgyal khab tu snyan tar 'bul gnang gi bka' lan du/ kru'u zhir sprod dngul 'gyur ldog thal lus mi 'byung ba'i dngul brjes bya phyogs zab gsal myur gsum 'dzoms pa 'thus legs byung 'dug pas sku srung gi lam gron yang chab cig dngul brjes kyis sprad 'thus dang / mi gcig ma bsdad thu med yod tshe rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang sdod dgos zhes bka' lan phebs don phrin mi tru'u krang brgyud dmag mi'i lam gron khang phu'u can la chabs cig dngul brjes kyis phul chog par dbyar 'grul stabs mtshungs la brten sku srung mang po dgos gal med pa dang / de yang bod sa zin mtshams nas phyir log bya rgyu/ phran tsho mi gcig ma bsdad thu med yod tshe sku zhabs blo bzang tshe dbang bzhugs rgyu bcas kyi bka' mol nges gtan gtsang mar 'khel te 'os sprul rin po che dang / yab chen/ stag 'tsher sogs sku 'bum lo yer khag phran tsho bcas zi ling du lhan phebs kyis thon kha'i mjal 'phrad zhu gnang mdzad/ de rjes tshang mar gsol tshigs shig phul song

64ba'i sne len zhu bar phrin mi hru'u krang dang / thing krang 'ga' shas ma gtogs rmā kru'u zhi rang phebs ma song / yul srol goms gshis dogs snang med pa sogs ji ltar yin rung dkar yol sder rtse chag skyon gzer shan rgyab pa'ang 'ga' shas 'dug /'os sprul rin po che gdan 'dren zhu ched drel byams che legs drel gseb sga gdan rang 'grigs gnyis sogs cha tshang dang / phran tsho mi bzhi so sor rta rkyang po re bcas/ phul sang /de nas sku 'bum du phyir phebs kyis phran dang / sku zhabs mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin gnyis stag tsher lo yer mdun phyag sne spom tshod dang / snam rigs sogs phul te 'os sprul rin po che yab yum sku 'khor rnams kyi phebs chas gra sgrig gnang sgo gang ci stag 'tsher sgar pa rang nas tshags tshugs skyabs 'jug gnang skyong yong ba zhus/tshes cha dang bstun ke'u tshang rin po che bzhugs yul che shos sgar pa rgyal mchog sku gong ma'i bzhugs khri sngon yod la brten 'os sprul rin po che gdan drangs na bza' sgron 'bul gyis bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khong/ de gsol ja dang / bzhes 'bras btegs rjes ke'u tshang

65rin po che nas maṣ+ṭal rten gsum dang bcas nga mo ngo g.yog rnams kyi mjal kha zhus te rten cing 'brel 'byung gi sarga phyin ci ma log par bsgrubs/ de nyin 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod stong sku 'bum gser sdong chen mor stong mchod dang / gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur nyin 'khyongs dang 'brel dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed rda sgor re bcas 'bul skabs 'os sprulī rin po che yang gnas gzigs su gdan zhus la sku 'bum dgon gzhung nas 'du khang gi sgo 'chor 'og tu bzhugs khri bshams 'dug par bzhugs zhabs 'khod rjes bla spyis gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / shing tog sogs bsnyen bkur bstabs shing / de nyin gnam gshis legs pa sogs gang sa nas gra rten legs 'grigs byung song /zi ling sgar dpon rwa sgreng bla brang gi mi 'gro a mdo bya khyung bsam 'grub dang bcas dbyar 'grul rnams thon tshes sogs sngon tshud nas bka' mol gtan khel legs par mdzad/ de sngon skye rgu mdo nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches nged tsho'i grogs dan du gtong gnang mdzad pa tshe mchog gling sprul sku 'ur du sus gdan zhus ltar

(haṃ6phebs shing / dngul chu sprul sku sku 'bum du rjes su bzhugs te bla zhabs byings che bozhugs yul skye rgu maro/ phyogs phebs gtan 'khel ba bcas lags sa//da ni gong gi rgyu mtshan las 'phros pa'i skabs su babs pa'i gnas lugs phran tsam 'god par bya ste/ de yang gong du gsal ba'i dmag sgar khag gnyis kyi ru dpon sogs stod rgyas bzungs 'khrid rjes ring por ma lon par rang gzhung rgyal khab nas byang brgyud zhi drag spyi khyab tu mkhan drung dngos gzhi ba thub bstan kun mkhyen ngo las gtos che srung dmag dang bcas ched brdzongs gnang ba ri bo cher bca' bzhugs thog stod rgya dang zhi ba'i ching mol byed par ja dang mda' dpon zur khang zur pa dang / ri bo che bla gnyer rtse drung las tshan rdo rje g.yul rgyal gnyis ched gtong gnang ba zi bod sa mtshams su zi ling rgya dpon dang mnyams 'dzoms bka' mol gyis phan tshun phar dgra tshur gnod mi byed pa sogs zhi mol legs 'grigs kyis ru dpon gnyis sogs sngon bzung rnams phyir 'bul zhus te rang khungs

67sngar rgyun dmag zhabs zhu mus dang / kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi ru dpon 'gyur med tshe brtan dmag zhabs zhus te lo mang yun song dmag dmangs spyi mos byas rjes che bar brten dmigs bsal gzigs bskyangs kyis dbus mda' dpon bahe/ gzhag stsal kyang 'o/ na ches mtho'i dbang gis gsar mjal zhu ma thub pa 'das rkyen bu gzhon pa bso/da nams bkra shis la pha shul bu 'dzin gyi ru dpon bsko gzhag dmigs bsal gyis bskyangs song /de 'brel gong gsal sku 'bum gser khri ho thog thu sku gong ma hu'u hu'u jag dmag nas me 'phen rkyen lam du gtong skabs mde'u dpral ba nas ltag rgyab thad phug byas yod pa bzhin yang srid nang ra'i stong dpon dbang chen gyi mnga' khongs che tsha'i 'brog sde pha thabs mkhas zer ba'i bur 'khrungs pa de'i dpral ba dang / ltag khung gnyis kar me mdel phogs shul rma rjes gsal nges masgyu nga ba tsam gyis ha las yid ches ngo mtshar che ba kun gyis mthodang chod du grub pa ma zad/de'i rjes spyi lo 1939 lo skor ri yin dang / gung phran bcas kyi dmag 'thab skor nub byang sa khul brgyad pa'i dgra 'gog dmag gi

68spyi khyab che ba kru'u zi ling krang kan zer ba rgya yul nas ched du 'byor te mtsho sngon blon po gser chen ri bo'i mdun thang mtsho mgo rgyal thang zhes par zi ling rmā kru'u zhis gtsos zi ling mtsho sngon khul gyi bla ma las sne dang / dpon rigs che khag rnams bzhugs mol tshogs 'du rgyas pa zhig tshugs te phan tshun ngo sprod 'tshams 'dri byed skabs gser khri'i yang srid chung ngu des me mdel phogs bshul la mdzub mo btsugs te rmā kru'u zhir mig ston ra sprod mdzad pa tshogs mi phal cher gyis mig mthong byung ba sogs skabs der tshogs 'dur phebs mi stong 'khor ho thog thu rin po che ngo ma deng sang mdo smad spyi 6 /thus mdzad de rda ram sa lar bzhugs mus kyi dgongs par mnga' gsal bcas rmā kru'u zhi'i byed ngan gyi skyon mtshang gsal brdol ma zad/ skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i rang rtags gsal thon 'di dag la bsams tshe gang zag shi ba'i tshe/mar me zhi ba ltar rig pa rgyun chad de 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba med pa sogs kyi log rtog rang shugs kyis ldog ste sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yid ches bla lhag tu rnyed nas rang rang gi phyi ma'i mtha' la rtog pa'i mno bsam zhig dpo sa par gda' na'ang chod gros ngan goms kyi mthu

69brtas pa bdag 'dra'i rigs la ni nges pa ci cha/srid 'byor nor la 'jungs pa'i chom rkun dag/yid kyi khang bur sbas pa'i rmongs pa 'ga'//dka' rnyog ngal ba 'byin pa'i tshig mtshon gyi//ral kha bkye ba'i g.yul ngo bshom la brel//'on tang gang 'tshams dbyig dang gleng sgros kyis//khengs dregs 'dod gtam gzhil ba'i co ga ni//klung chen 'ahros dang bstun pa'i gru gzings bzhin//ma ce ra byus kyi mtsho chen brgal ba'i thabs /dkon pa'i mchog gcig nor gyi snying po la//rin du bcal ba rmongs pa'i rang mtshang ste//sgyu ma'i nor las 'dod 'byung bsam 'phel dbang //bsil ldan bstan 'gro'i gnyen du thob la soms//zu
