70le'u drug pa/bod ljongs rgyal khab chen por chibs zhal bsgyur tshul/phyi sku 1939 lnga da rgyal 'o( 20snyo6 sa yos zla snyo tshes 1 nyin spyi nor 7gong sa rngoskyabs mgon chen po'i 'os sprul rin po che mchodag dang / sku'i gcen wa blo bzang bsam gtan lags gnyis kru'u zhis phul ba'i drel byams dang / rgyal yum chen mor sgar pa'i drel byams/ rgyal yab chen mo dang / sku'i gcen wa rgyal 'o/ ro/na 'grub mchodag stag 'tsher sgar pa'i 'o/ yer bgres gzhe na/ ke'u tshang rin ngo ches gtsos phran tsho lnga gasku ga so/gas gyi ling gi bzhon pa la brten te sku 'bum dbo na nas gangs can gyi phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bskyod skabs kun gsal sgeg mo nyi 'od kyi snang ba ches cher ngom zhing / bar bar du bkra shis pa'i gzugs dbyibs sna chodags kyi chu 'dzin thor bu bkra ba las sbrang char zim bur babs pa sogs lnga mtshar

71rten 'byung gi dge mtshan du ma dang bcas phebs te dred khog zhal dkar lung 'dab rtse chu khar dbu gur sgron te bca' bzhugs gnang /sku'i gcen mo tshe ring sgron ma gtan zhal gnyis kyang de bar chibs skyel du phebs nas phyir log mdzad/ 7rgyal ba'i yang srid du gsal bsgrags ma thub pa'i nyer len sogs ji ltar yang sku 'bum dgon gyi thabs skyel ser sbreng sogs med/ gong gi bzhugs zhag sar stong 'khor dgon pa'i gdan zhu'i mi sna 'gyor zhing / zla snyo tshes shar stong 'khor dgon thub bstan bshad sgrub gling du phebs skabs zho lung mdo zhes bar phebs bsu rta pa dang / bkra shis thang du thab bsu gsol ja bzhes 'bras/ dgon 'gram ser sbreng dang / bla ma las sne'i spos sna dang stong 'khor bla brang du gdan zhus gsol ston bstar zhing / bla gra shog khog gsum gyi mi dmangs bcas nas mjal kha zhu+os/ sku'i+o ngal gsar bca' zhag gnang grags zhu rung khang phu'u than krang nga g.yog 'ga' shas der 'byor gyis rta khal sogs sngon btang zin gshis sang nyin rang chibs lnga na gnang dgos zhus pa sogs kyis bzhugs zhags lhag sngo gnang kho ma byung ma song zhing / nangs par

72phebs thon gnang skabs gong bzhin ser sbreng spos sne dang bcas dgon gyi gtsug lag khang gi sa gzhi'i mthil du 'thor nas rnams nor bu dga' 'khyil gyi gzugs dbyibs gsal pos ma bcos rang grub tu byung ba der yod bla grwa mang pos mig mthong gis ngo mtshar gyi tshad du brtsi ba byung 'dug stong 'khor dgon nas sku zhabs blo bzang tshe dbang sku 'bum du phyir log gis rjes su bzhugs dgos la brten phan tshun tshang ma blo pham yid skyo tshad med bsam bcadad las 'das pa zhig byung yang myur mjal gyi smon pa tsam las thabs sku da du ma gyur/ 'os sprul rin po che sku 'khor rnams nyin ltar 'char can nam zin la chibs thon gnang ste nyin gung yas mas dbyar 'grul babs tshugs rtswa kha gang bzang so sor dbu gur sgron phub tu bzhugs zhag gnang bzhin rim phebs mdzad/ mtsho sngon nye 'gram rdo nyi zla'i la rgyab nas bzung dngul brjes bya yul khang phu'u thon krang can dang / zi ling kru'u zhis sku srung dpon dmag gi lam gron dngul 'bab blangs pa tsam las dngos su dpon dmag zur gtong med par gnas mjal bskyod mi'i khongs rmā yon had si krang zer bar sku srung gi ming 'dogs byas pa bcas hu'u

7ponahū'u dang / bod tshong dbyar 'grul khag sogs bzhugs sgar dang 'dabs 'brel lhan cig tu yod/ bzhugs zhag gar gnang gi nye mtshams phan tshun du yod pa'i bod sog 'brog rigs mjal khar bcar mi ha cang mang bar brten phyag rjen gyi phyag dbang stsal rgyu sku ngal chung khyad gzugs sngags dang byin rten gyi 'thum por dar gyi phyang 'khrul btags pa'i dar dpyangs gsar bzo dang 'brel 'os sprul rin sngo che zhabs stegs thog gdan zhu gnang ste mjal kha btang / tsha 'dam zer bar bca' zhag gcig gnang thog sang nyin snga dro rta drel rtsa khar btang ba nyin gung tsam nas tshur bskongs te mi yi 'thung chu yang khal thog 'khyer nas rdog thon gyis rtswa med chu med zer ba'i lung par sa srib khar 'gyor la zhag mal mdzad/ de nub rta drel la sran chag phran bu ster ba tsam las ltogs par 'jog dgos la brten nye skor du mi'i rgyu 'grul skabs rta drel gyi skad dang / lag brdab kyi rdog sgras lung pa khengs 'gro ba lta bu 'dug de nas nam phyed tsam la phebs thon gyis rtsa chu phran bu yod sa sbra nag zer bar nyin gzhung 'byor te zhag bzhugs gnang dgos 'dug pa sogs byang stong du nyin zhag mang por

74phebs dgos la brten skabs re 'os sprul rin po che sku na phra bas ngal bsun gyi rnam pa lta bus sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan lags su drel byams nang bsun bsnyad mdzad de bshums dgos pa re gnyis tsam byung sku(nga ba las sku khams bde min sogs kyi gra ma 'grigs gang yang ma byung zhing / yab chen thugs sems bzang lnga / rta drel la thugs mnyes ha cang che gshis nyin ltar tshugs zhag babs rjes nged tsho'i ngo g.yog dang mnyam 'dres kyis yang yang bzhugs par rang ngos 7rgyal yab sngo mar nges pa'i nang ro/na ༄ gas gshis 'jigs 'tsher sku nga bzhin yang / mna' dam sngon yod la brten dgag dgos dbang gis snang med rang mnyam lta bu mi byed thu med yong gi 'dug rgyal yum chen mo ni drel byams nang dang / tshugs sa so sor phyag bzo 'tshem drub phar phyin skyon bzhugs kyis nged tshos yang yang mi mjal/ lung chung skyid po zer bar nag chu'i sa srung rta dmag rnams dang 'phrad pas nged tsho tshang mar rang yul du slebs song snyam pa'i dga' spro'i snang ba 'char zhing / rta dmag rnams nas bsang dud kyi mchod pa dang 'brel phebs bsu'i mjal dar phul rjes rta mchog gi bzhon pa'i rtsal 'gran

75la zhugs te ki sgra dang bcas lus kyi ldem 'gyur dang / glo bur 'bab zhon sogs rtsal 'don byed 'dug par 'os sprul rin po ches dgyes nyams chen po mdzad/ zi ling sgar dpon nas dbyar 'grul rnams la mjal kha yong ba snyan gsang sngon zhus ltar am tshar shu gu zer ba'i bzhugs zhag sar na spang dras btubs kyi bzhugs khri sgron bshams dang 'brel sgar dpon nas maṣ+ṭal rten gsum 'degs 'bul dang bcas dbyar 'grul rnams la mjal kha zhus/ drel byams gdan zhu drel gseb gcig sha gshed ngan pa dang bcas zhag tshugs snga ba byung skabs sgar pa'i dre'u che nying khag la byams 'gel sbyong bdar gyis chad sor mdzad/ nub gcig hu'u hu'i rta rdzi nas la phar nang rta pa mang po yod lugs zer 'phral sgar shog rnams tshogs 'du tshugs te thab khag re nas mi rta go hrag 'phrul mda' rang 'grigs re go bsgrigs kyis mtshan mo sgar bskor dang / nyin mo phebs thon skabs phyed cha snga sor sngon thon dang / phyed cha rjes sor mjug sdod bcas nyin lnga drug ring byed dgos byung song rung / rkun jag sogs kyis glagasaṃ blta ba gang yang ma byung /

76sku 'bum nas phebs thon gyi zla gsum 'gro nye'i mtshams mthu stobs chu kha'am/ rwa sgreng rab kha zer bar lha ldan rgyal khab chen po nas rtse phyag thub bstan thar 'dod dang / bla phyag gsar byung sras gdong thugs mkho gsol rtsam/ gro zhib/ rta chag sogs dang / chu sgrol ko ba bzhi bcas 'byor/ chu bo de tsam cher rgyas mi 'dug kyang /ko ba ched 'byor zin par brten 'os sprul rin po che ko ba'i nang gdan 'dren zhu gnang la dgyes mnyes kyi rnam pa chen po mdzad kyin 'dugabazhugs zhag sar rtse shod phyag mdzod ngo las nas mjal phyag zhugs gnang mdzad/ lam bar 'dam dang / na kha spo mtho/ gzhan yang sa rong rtsub pa sogs drel byams bde thar med sa khag la 'os sprul rin po che sku zhabs mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin dang / nged gnyis res mos kyi sgal rgyab tu gdan 'dren zhus shing / nged rang gnyis kyang shed shugs dang rgyab 'khur gyi myong goms med rkyen sgal par gdan zhu byed po der gcig shos nas lag sbrel gyis 'khyor 'gros dgos pa yang mang po yong gi 'dug mod/ bsod nams kyi skal ba mchog tu bsams te dka' ngal gyi 'du shes cung zad kyang ma byung / phebs lam 'di

77dag 'char can dbyar 'grul bgrod lam de rang yin 'dug stabs stong 'khor dgon nas bzung nag chur ma son pa'i bar bar du 'brog dud sbra gur thar thor tsam 'a/sa grong khyim rigs mi 'dug /mtsho sngon nye 'gram shugs ba lung pa zer ba'i lung tshan gcig la nags tshal gang 'tshams 'dug pa las/ bying che sngo ljang ni'u gsing rgyas pa'i spang gshong dang / spang ri'i de'u ma gtogs nags tshal rigs mi 'dug cing / 'brong dang / sha rkyang / dgo bo/ gtsod sogs ri dwags sna tshogs snang / tshwa 'dam yas mas su rnam kun rta drel sog/sa 'dam tshud kyis 'chi god dang / dug sbrang gi nyer 'tshe/ skabs re rta zog rtswa zar 'grems rgyags sa nas ri dwags rkyang khyus rta drel dang / 'brong khyus mdzo g.yag 'ded 'khrid sogs 'grul mi rnams la dka' ngan ci che yong dang yong bzhin yin 'dug kyang / skabs der dug sbrang thar thor dang / 'dag 'dam phran bu ma gtogs skyon gnod dka' ngal gang yang byung ma song bas/ zing 'gyul rgan rabs rgyus can rnams nas de sngon 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po rgya sog yul gru nas phyir phebs bskyangs skabs da lam ji bzhin byung tshul thos

78pa tsam las/ rnam kun babo da bde 'di rigs mi yong zhing / da lam yang 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i mchodag sprul yang srid rin wa che'i thugs rje bka' drin yin nges zhes dad mo sa chen wa sa gleng ba byung song / lung chung skyid po zhes pa'i nye 'gram rdo raka sha zer ba'i lung pa zhig nang rdo hrug phal cher phreng ba raka sha lta bu'i 'bur kyong mang yod kyi hril mo khyon che 'dug pa tsam ma galta/gas lam bar sa gnas kyi khyad chodas gzhan lngar mtshar che rigs dmigs bsal ma malnga nga /cadas sprul rin po che sku 'kho ra rnams rgya mi'i sa mtshams kyi nyen 'gan gro la cho da tsam la lha ldan rgyal khab tu tshes cha bzang bsdun gyi bkra shis chodags 'du rgyas 'dzoms tshogs te so/sa sprul rin po che 7rgyal mchodag sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen wa'i mchogag gi sprul skur thag bcad dril bsgrags gnang 'dug pa'i thog /phebs bsur bla phyag sne shar thub bstan thar pa ('di phyi srid bka' slon deng sang a mi ri kar bzhugs pa de red )dang / rim bzhi rin sgang ngo las gdong 7rgyal ba'i dbu gur ser rbo stabs bde zhig dang bca sa gtong gnang mdzad 'dug pa khra tshang la brgyab ste 'bum chen zhes pa'i sa gnas su me tog ser chen lhun

79por spungs pa la 'gran bzod pa'i dbu gur ser po'i nang bzhugs khri dar zab kyis g.yogs pa'i steng mchog gi sprul sku rin po che gdan zhus kyis bla phyag sne shar nas maṣ+ṭal rten gsum 'degs 'bul dang bcas phebs bsur gsar 'khyedar rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ de nas bzung bzhugs zhag gar khel du dbu gur ser po 'ba' zhig sgron mus/skabs der yab yum sku gas nas 7rgyal ba'i yang srid nges gtan khel ba gzhi nas mkhyen lto gas byung zhing / rgyal yab chen wa zhal sang ngo yin gshis khyed rnams kyis nga tshor da bar dngos gnas mi shod pa gang yin zhes gsung gi 'dug par 7rgyal ba'i yang srid thugs gtan khel ba gzhan gyi shes na zi ling kru'u zhis bkag 'bo ga gis ngo da la dbang sgyur byed sems kyis mtshon dran 'khrul ji yong nges med sogs khe nyen che rkyen gsang rgya bya rgyur nga chod mna' bskyal ba'i 'o/ rgyus zhib cha zhus pas dgongs pa dwangs po byung ste gsang ba byas pa yag po zhe drag red ces gsung gi 'dug dbu gur ser po sgron mtshams nas nag chur ma phebs bar nyin ltar bzhugs zhag sgar gral gyi dbu gur rgyang ring nas mig gis mthong mtshams char zim bu dang / skabs re ser

80ba phran tsam re chag med babs song /rgyal khab nas a drung ched mngags gdong bka' rgya nang 'byor du / 'di lo zla 9 zla nag la brten mchog sprul yang srid rin po che lha ldan rgyal khab chen por zla 10 tshes shar la zhabs sor 'khod pa bya rgyur de rtsis dal 'grod kyis gdan zhu dgos rgyu zhes gsal skor ke'u tshang rin po che sku gas nga tsho ngo las bka' mol gyis sa stong la dal bgrod bya rgyu 7rgyal ba'i sku phywa'i nyen 'gan bzod bral la brten zla 9 zla nag yin tshe lha rab zla 8 nang lha sar gdan zhu thub thabs dang / ci ste zla 10 bar mi 'gyangs thu med yin tshe gus snumis o tshod dal sdod zhu rgyu blos 'gan baX da thabs rtsa ba nas bral gshis nag chu'i nye mtshams bar da mus tshugs zhag sngar rgyun ltar gdan zhu bya rgyur nag chu'i nye mtshams su sku phywa'i thugs 'gan bzod thub pa'i bla dpon che khag su 'os shig chibs sgyur yong ba mi zhu thu med ltar byung bstun zla zhag yun 'gyangs ji dgos bka' bstun phebs sgug zhus chog pa zhes 'u thug gi snyan zhu gnang dgos byung rkyen lha sa nas zhabs pad bon cadad pa mo gas phebs bsur phebs mkhan

81 rnams bka' shag thugs spro'i mjug skyel dang / phyogs chas rgyas gshom gra sgrig gnang mus ji bzhin ma grub par glo bur tshab tshub nyin mtshan ltos med kyis phebs dgos byung bas lom bar mtshano gung rta khal ljung lus dang / sku chas phran bu brlag star chu shar sags sku mnyel chen po byung ba'i skor sogs kyi skad cha mang po 'dug cing /gang ltar lha sa nas nyin lam bcu skor gyi sa gnas dga' bzhi na mo che zer bar zhabs pad bon shod pa dang / mkhan drung bkras gling pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug sku bcar gsol dpon che ba blo bzang sbyin pa (deng skabs 'dir yod kyi gsol che de rang red )gdan sa rnam gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ gzhung zhabs ser skya dang / mgron gzim/ gasku la thab pa/ gur gdan 'go pa sogs hrag bsdus bcas phebs su'i dbu gur bzhugs khri sku/gas gra bsgrigs kyis zhabs pad bon shod pa dang /mkhan drung mkhyen dbang / gsol che blo sbyin sogs gtso bo 'ga' shas nam ma lang gong sa bzhu bsnams te yar tsam phebs 'byor gyis drel byams gyi drung du bcar skabs yang srid rin po che drel byams nang mnal gzim nas yod pa sku na phra rkyen mnal sun snang dogs sdud g.yeng

82byung rung / ke'u tshang rin po che nas drel byams gzim yol phye 'phral thugs sun 'tsher sogs med par dgyes 'dzum gasku bzhin phebs bsu ba rnams la thugs zhib kyis phebs bsu'i mjal dar ke'u tshang rin po che nas bzhes te rang slog stsal thog chung srid rin po che nas lcug phran gazlogen nu'i yal 'dab ltar mnyen pa'i phyag g.yas brkyangs pa'i byin rlabs legs par 355 ba dang nam langs pa dus mnyams shing /de nas phebs bsu'i dbu gur du phebs pa dang rta bdun bdag po'i 'od snang sa gzhir khyab pa dus mtshungs byung ba sogs ma bsgrigs lhan 'grub kyi rten 'brel legs pa byung / dbu gur nang mchog sprul yang srid rin po cher mnab rung gi na bza' gsar pa gzhung gnas nas 'du mdzad pa dag sgron 'bul gyis bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod/gsol ja bzhes 'bras rim btegs rjes zhabs pad cadan phyo da pa mo gas nas 'khri shing dud pa lta bu'i gus phyag sngon du 'gro ba'i maṣ+ṭal sku gsung thugs rten 'degs 'bul thog 7rgyal tshab/ tshogs 'du/ bka9ram̐ shag sogs kyi zhu rgyu dang rten chas kyi bdog pa rnams phul/ mdzad sgo grub bstun yang srid rin po che phebs ḍi ser po'i nang gdan zhus

83thog phebs bsu snga rjes kyi chibs rag bstar bsgrigs dang / phebs lam g.yas g.yon du lam 'khel dgon pa khag gi ser sbreng dung rgya rnga rol 'bud brdungs/ yul 'brog gi bro gzhas/ dga' gus phyogs 'dus kyi ser skya mi mang tshan po che spyi byings kyang rang rang yul lugs kyi rgyan gos gzab gyon bstar bsgrigs/ bsang dud lha lam 'khrigs bzhin par sa yos bod zla 8 tshes nyin nag chu zhabs brtan dgon par zhabs sor 'khod/ sgrub khang bla brang sogs de ga'i bla gra mi ser spyi sger nas dkar spro dang / mja' phyag 'bul nod rgya cher btegs/phebs bsu zhabs pad bon shod ngo las rnams lha sa nas brel tshub kyis brtab brtab poratsaphebs dgos byung rkyen las zhabs 'ga' shas rjes lus rnams phebs lam dang / nag chu sogs la snga rting rim 'byor byung song / nag chur ser skya mi mang 'du 'dzoms che ba rnams nas mjal kha yong ba'i re 'dun shin tu che gshis sku 'khrugs sogs kyi nyen 'gan mi 'byung ched/ tshang ma zhabs dgon rdo bcal nang 'bod 'gugs kyis spyi nor yang srid rin po che dgon gyi yang steng ke'u chang rin po che'i sku pang thog gdan zhu mdzad de phyag nas 'thor gnang

84mdzad song bar da ni bod la skyid pa'i nyi ma shar song zhes dga' ba'i skad 'bod byed mi mang po 'dugasku bcar gsol dpon che ba blo bzang sbyin pa sku gong ma'i dus kyi gsol dpon la brten thog mar mjal nyid nas sngar 'dris ji bzhin thugs 'tsher gyi rnam pa bral bas/ de nas bzungs te nyin mtshan 'bral med du zhabs zhu mdzad/ nag chur bzhugs zhag gnyis gnang rjes dgon khag gi ser sbreng dang / yul 'asnga ga gi lnga gzhas sogs kyi phebs skyel dang bcas chibs kyi kha lo sgyur/ 'dam dbu ma thang du 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che sku 'khor rnams dang / sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po ngag dbang bstan 'dzin sogs phebs te bzhugs sgar mdzad 'dug par bzhugs zhag thodag /mchodad yon mjal 'dzoms gyi mdzad sgor 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che nas maṭaṃl rten gsum 'degs 'bul dang 'brel phebs ston dkar spro 'bul gnang mdzad/de nas bka' gdams sprul pa'i glegs bam nang gsal chos rgyal dkon mchodag 'bangs la o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 〈sna rje'i glu yi lung bstan pa'i gnas/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i chu mgo

85rwa sgreng dge 'phel gling dgon par de ga'i dge 'dun rnams dang / nye skor btsun dgon bsam gtan gling gi btsun ma bcas kyi ser sbreng dang / ༷/la 'asnga/ga gi bro gzhas/ lha mo ba sku gas bstar bsgrigs kyis gdan drangs te rwa sgreng bla brang gi yang steng gzim chung nyi 'od du zhabs sor 'kho da bstun bro gzhas lha mo ba sogs kyi gzigs 'bul zhus/de'i phyi nyin rngorgyal tshab rin po ches spos sne dang bcas rwa sgreng gi gtsug lag khang chen ngo ra gdan drangs te 7rgyal mchodag sku thodang ma'i bzhugs khrir zhabs sen gyi pasdud rnam par bkod pa la/ rwa sgreng bla brang nas gsol ston dkar dre bsgrigs 'bul thog rgyal tshab rin po che nas maṭaṃl rten gsum 'degs 'bul mdzad mjug masprodad pa dza sag gis mchosan pa'i bla brang gi zhabs gras rnams dang / dge 'phel gling dgon pa'i las sne 'dus spyi bcas nas/ mjal phyag dang 'brel dngos 'byor gyi bdog pa'i mchod sprin bstar/ de nas rten gtso dpal mnyam med jo bo chen po a ti sha'i thugs dam rten jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / jo bo'i gdung rten du 'brom rin po ches bzhengs pa'i dngul gdung khyung mgo can/ 'brom rin po'i gzigs dpe brgyad stong

86pa'i glegs bam 11gas nang rten byine rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba rnams la mchod 'bul gnas gzigs zhib par bskyangs grub rjes/ yul 'awa ga so skusna nas phyogs 'dus mi 'phra ra shin tu che bar gtsug lag khang gi yang steng nas mthong grol zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dgyes 'dzum lhug par bo(la bzhin par byin rlabs kyi phyag gnas 'thor gnang bka' drin bskyangs/ nyin gcig sku 'khor stabs bde'i thog dgon gsham chu 'gram du sgo khang 'dug par rgyal tshab rin po che nas gdan zhus mdzad/ ke'u tshang rin po che sogs nga tsho zi ling du bskyod mi ngo las so sos rgyal tshab rin po cher gzim chung mjal kha zhus/ rwa sgreng du bzhugs zhag gsum gnang ring ston 'khor rnams la rwa sgreng bla brang nas bsnyen bkur gyi zhabs tog legs par bsgrubs/ 7rgyal ba'i yab yum sku mched rnams la rgyal khab nas sngaged lugs na bza' sku brgyan rgyas bsdus cha tshang gsar bcadas kyis bsnams 'dug pa 'bul gnang mdzad song rung / rgyal yab chen po dang / sku gcen rnam gnyis gos chen 'jam sangs kyi na bza' mtshal phyu dang / tshon khra'i sku stod sgog rtse dang / sbyar sbyar tsam las gzhan dag ma bzhes khar/ lhag

87par rgyal yum chen mo'i sku rgyan brje bzhes gnang ma sku nga ba 'di bzhin rjetra/ su zhib skabs rang lugs sgyur bathodas ma mdzad pas mchodzig phal gzhan dang 'dres 'dzol med pa'i ngo gzengs sgon pa yag po byung 'dugarwa sgreng nas phebs thon skabs dge 'dun rnams nas dgon gsham bar ser sbreng bstar bsgrigs dang / bla ma las sne sogs kyis pho brang thang bar phebs skyel du bcar bar mja' dar rang slog stsal/de nas chag la brgal te 'phan po'i yul ljongs brgyud bye ri stag rtse rdzong zhes sngar sde srid stag rtse ba'i rdzong rnying gi 'dab rol sogs gsol tsha bzhugs zhag gar 'khel du dbu gur sgar bsgrigs mdzad/'brom stod du zhabs pad gnang byung pa dang / dza sag tsha rong pa / tha'i ji shan kha ba/ mtshan zhabs stag brag rin po che ('di'i rjes su srid skyong gnang mkhan de red )sku bcar mchodad dpon mkhan po byams pa legs dza gas sogs rtse shod drung rigs phebs bsu tsho khag gcig phebs 'dug pas mjal kha zhus/ mchod dpon mkhan sngotsware sku rgyab tu 7rgyal ba rim byon gyi thugs dam rten gzim chung lha mo gsung byon ma'i sku thang bsnams 'dug pa yang sring/ rin po ches gzigs 'phral

88gzhan gyis rgyus mnga' zhu mi gang yang med rung / de ma thag thang sgam zhal 'byed kyis ma bu 'phrad pa lta bu'i dgyes chor chen po gnang zhing /phebs bsu de'i khong gzim 'gag bgres pa dga' ldan go bo byang chub lags kyang 'dug khong ni 7rgyal mchog sku gong ma'i sku dus nas gzim 'gag gi zhabs zhu zhus te yun ring song zhing / bar lam bsnyun babs lci byung skabs spyan ras gzigs kyi mchog sprul yang srid rin po che ma mjal bar shi yang dbugs 'gro ba mi 'dug ces sman bcos 'phrod gces gnang ste drag 'gro ba zhig red/ khong mchog sprul yang srid rin po che mjal ba tsam gyis dga' ches nas mi tshugs pa dang /sku thang zhal 'byed mdzad babs sogs la ha las yid ched dad gdung mnyam 'gran lta bus mang du bshums pa'i thog nga rang la'ang lag pa nas 'jus te da res khyed rnam pas dka' las brgyags go chod 'dug thugs rje shin tu nas che/ khyed rnams tshe ring nad med yong ba'i smon lam brgyab kyi yin/ da ni shi yang 'gyod pa med ces spyan chab mang po gnang gi 'dug mi rdzig po gzugs stobs che zhing /skad sbom pa/ dpung pa gru bzhi/ dgung lo bgres pa zhig nas spyan

89chab gnang skabs nged rang sogs der yod phal cher ha las ya mtshan dga' skyo zung 'brel gyis mig chu rang dbang med par shor yong gi 'dug de bzhin der 'dus gzhung zhabs dang / ser skya mi mang khongs nas kyang bod la bde skyid bsnams phebs mkhan khyed tsho thugs rje che zhes zhal zhe med pa'i ngo bstod gnang mkhan mang po byung /gzhung gi phebs bsu dngos gzhi mdzad yul sgang stod 'dod rgu thang du ma phebs gong ri rgya bsam gtan gling ri khrod du gzhung gnas nas gsol tsha gra bsgrigs kyis phebs bsur gzhung zhabs ser skya phal cher 'dug rgyal yum chen mo yang 'di nas chibs thog tu phebs/sgang stod 'dod rgu thang du mdzod gos ser po las grub pa'i dbu gur rma chen mo zhes mjal gur chen po dang / yol sgor gyi phyi nang gnyis kyi bar du gzim gur/ zhal 'don khang / gsol ba khang sogs stag lpags/ sa/zigs lpags/ mdzod gos ser po sogs las grub pa'i phying gur gzugs rnams dang / yol gor gyi phyi rol du rgyal tshab rin po che dang / srid blon/ yab gzhis/ zhabs pad rnam pa nas bzung gzhung zhabs drung drag 'bring dkyus gsum/ rtse shod phyag mdzod las

90khungs khag dang bcas pa'i dbu gur gral rim bstar bsgrigs phyi nang rim pa gsum gyis mkhyud mo ra bskor ba sogs mdor na rgyu skar gyi do shal sa gzhir bkram pa la 'gran bzod pa'i bzhugs sgar sgar bsgrigs rgyas pa 'du mdzad pa'i 'jing dbus su spyan 'dren rgyur/bka' blon/ gung / dza sag dar han/ twa bla ma/ dar rgan/ tha'i ji / drung rtsis/ mda' dpon/ rtse shod phyag mdzod/ lha zhol gnyer mi dawa na sogs zhi drag gi bya ba'i sner galta gas pa'i gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs rdzogs dang / dga' ldan khri gdan zur/ shar byang chos rje / gdan sa chen po rnam gsum dang / rgyud gra smad stod/ rnam gra/ gnas chung / gling phan tshun/ rme bzhi lcags gsum/ gzhis dgon khag sogs kyi mkhan po bla sprul las sne/ sa bkras gnyis kyi mi sna/ ju gzhung 'go pa/ rgya gar/ rgya nag kha bal 'bras 'brug sogs kyi sku tshab bcas nas bzhugs sgar nye mtshams su gral phreng bstar bsgrigs dang / dmag sgar khag nas ru bsgrigs bcas kyis phebs bsu zhus te dbu gur chen mo'i bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod/gsol ston dkar spro'i thog rgyal tshab rin po che dang / srid blon nas

91 maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul gnang rjes phebs bsu tshang mas mjal kha zhu gnang sogs rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo rgyas par mdzad de bzhugs zhag bcag mal gnyis gnang /phyi 'o/ 1939 lnga da rgyal lo 2066 sa yos zla 8 tshes 25 gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin lha ldan gser gyi rgyal khab chen por zhabs sor 'khod rgyu'i snga dro rdo dar gyi rol cha dang gnyis kyi brdas bskul te chibs dar/ chibs rol/ gzim 'bogs/ rnam grwa rgyab cha ba/ rtsed shod drung rigs drag 'bring dkyus gsum/ malha na gnyer/ gzim 'gag gasdudal gzim mchod gsum /zhabs pad rnam pa/ rgyal tshab rin po che dang / srid blon/ gdan sa gsum gyi bla sprul mawa/ na po las sne sku gas chibs rag bying sngar srol chibs sgyur chen mo'i lam ston gzhir bzung zab cing rgyas pa'i thogake'u tshang rin po che'i dgongs gzhir yang srid gdan zhu ngo las rnams phyogs chas gnang bzhed kyi kho ngas nas sku zhabs mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin la sku bcar gzim dpon mkhan po bsko bzhag stsal gshis na bza' gra chas bzhes pa dang / ke'u tshang rin po che na bza' phyogs

92chas bcas kyis phebs byams chen morware g.yas g.yon du phebs shing /nged rang yang lho gas chas kyis phebs byams sku rgyab tu gdan sa'i bla sprul khag gi sngon du yab gzhis sku ngo rnams gdan zhus kyis maro/ra na sa gzhi thams cad yom yom du 'dar ba snyam byed pa'i chibs rag zad mi shes pa brgya byin nye dbang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'am/ zla ba nya pa rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba la ba'i 'khe ra tshogs rgya mtsho'i ta ༄dbus su/ 'jig rten gsum gyi rnam par 'dren pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i mchog gi sprul sku rin po che nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin 'bar zhing / mthong na grol ba'i mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor dgyes 'dzum lhug par grol ba'i spyan ras kyi gzigs pa g.yo ba tsam gyis skye rgu'i gdung ba ma lus pa sel ba'i dge mtshan 'bum phrag dang bcas te chibs kyi kha lo bskyod pa na/ dgon gnas dang / grong dang grong khyer/ gtsug lag khang dang / pho brang yas mas la sogs pa'i yang steng nas bsangs kyi dud sprin lha lam 'gengs pa dang / 'bud brdung dkrol ba'i rol mo'i bye brag gnam sa g.yo ba tsam sgrog cing dar gyi lda lji dang / ba dan/ rgyal mtshan la sogs pa nam mkhar sgreng bas

93bar snang stong pa'i khams kyang 'gengs pa lta bu dang / phebs lam gyi g.yas g.yon du ngur smrig gi gos kyis klubs pa'i dge 'dun pa stong phrag mang pos mchod rdzas sna tshogs bsnams pa'i ser sbreng /rgyal srid sna bdun dong / stag seng khyung 'byug 'brong rtsedo/ bro pa/ gzhas cha// rnga shan/ 'bag shan sags chas gas bzang pa dang rgyan gyi khyad par phun sum tshogs pas spa pa du mas glu gzhas zodal cha sna tshogs/ dmag sgar khag gi 'go dmag nas ru bsgrigs gus 'dud/7rgyal ba'i 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal bar rgyang ring mo nas lhag pa dang bcas pa'i ser skya pho mo rgan gzhon bar gsum rang lugs gyon chas gzab pa gang na ci yod gyon pa'i tshogs bgrang gi mi lang ba sa gzhi'i khyon kun dog por byas pa dag gis rang dbang bde skyid ces pa la sogs pa'i rkang bro glu gzhas dang / rol cha'i sgra snyan nam mkha' gang ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su mthong thos dran reg gi skye dgu rnams kyi re ba 'bras bu dang ldan par mdzad de phebs skabs mi mang gi khrod nas mchod cig da ni skyid pa'i nyi ma shar song zhes skad chen po brgyab ste gar stabs gnam mchong byed pa dang / zhabs bro rgyag pa / 'di

94 'dra rmi lam yin nam malnga na surme yin zhes ngu ba sogs dga' bas mi tshugs pa'i rnam 'gyur sna hrūganas ci dang ci yang ston zhing / chibs gral du yab gzhis sku ngo rnams mthong skabs 'di 'dra'i na bza' cha byad ya mtshan khyad dzadas lnga na la mjal bag lha ba zhes dga' gus tshad med zhu 'dug pa ma zad/ nged rang yang gzhung zhabs gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba'i phyogs chas kyis yab gzhis sku ngo rnam pa'i sku gdong du yod par brten ngo mi shes pa rnams nas 'di bod pa yin pa 'dra su red ces phan tshur 'dri gleng byed cing / ngo shes pa rnams nas 'grul bskyod lam ngal gyis rgas rgud chen ngo byas 'dug /yin kyang dka' las brgyags r+sha chodad shag thugs rje che zhes tshang mas dgyes mnyes smon 'debs mang po mdzad kyin 'dug pas rang la blo nus kyi kha stabs ci yang ma mchis sdudad/ cosan kyang 7skyabs mthodan mchodag gi thugs bskyed bden mthu dang / gangs ljongs skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi mthu dpal zung du 'brel ba'i stobs kyis zhabs 'degs phran bu grub pa 'dra snyam pa'i dga' ba dang / khengs spobs mnyam 'gran lta bu byung /phebs lam/ du chos skyong khag dang / stag seng khyung 'brug gi

95gsob/ 'awa nga rtsed sogs zang zing sna tshogs spyi dang / lhag par lha ldan gsung chos ra bar gzhung brten dgra lha'i gtso bo gnas chung chodas rgyal chen po rten gzhir khog brlams kyis phebs bsu'i mjal dar 'bul bzhes bskyangs dgos la brten de rigs sngon chad gzigs snu nga med pa'i zang zing brjid nyams che ba yod gshis sku na phra rkyen 'jigs zhum mdzad mi yong ngam zhes nga ces gdan zhu ngo las rnams bka' mol sngon byung de ltar yang / de nyin gsung rar gnang chung chos rgyal chen pos phebs byams gyi drung du bcar nas gus phyag pad 'bul dang 'brel dbu rmog lcog dar sogs sne mang brjid sgrom che ba phebs byams kyi gzim sgor 'khon thogs med par hril gyis tshud de mjal dar 'bul gnang skabs mchog sprul yang srid rin po che nas kyang 'jigs zhum phra mo tsam med par sngar 'dris kyi ngo shes 'phrad pa lta bu'i dgyes nyams dang bcas mjal dar chos skyong gi mgul du rang slog stsal rjes chos skyodang gi phyag gis phebs byams byams mda'i zur nas 'chang ste phar tsam gdan drangs pa bcas mjal tshe der yod tshang ma ha las lnga mtshar yid chesatsachen pos bstod bsngags kyi zodal

96mo sgrog pa byung song /de nas lha ldan ra sa 'khrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du rten mchog rnams kyi spyan sngar gnas gzigs dang 'brel jo bo shākya mu zhe'i sku mdun pang gcal steng bde stan thog bzhugs zhabs 'khod de gsung zhabs rnam grwa rnams dang bcas khrus gasku/la rab gnas kyi zhal 'don bskyangs shing / de'i ring yab gzhis sku ngo rnams mi dbang byams pa'i lha khang nang bzhugs 'jags mdzad de gsol 'bras phebs sgo rim bzhin phebs/gnas gzigs grub bstun chibs rag gral rim gong bzhin gyis 7rgyal mchodag gong ma na rim gyi bzhugs gnas yid 'ong ljon shing 'khrigs pa'i skyed tshal/ sde bzhi'i dge mtshan ngang gis 'du ba nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du chibs bsgyur gyis gzim chung nyi 'od 'dod rgu 'khyil ba'i 'jigs med seng ge'i khri la khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i mchog gi sprul sku rin po che lhan po la nyin mor byed pas mdzes pa lta bur mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mthong na mi mthun pa med pa lham

97me lhan ne lhang nger brjid chags gzi byin gyi snang ba rgyas shing lhun chags pa la/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che dang / srid blon yab gzhis glang mdun gung kun dga' dbang phyug bka' blon rnam pas gtsos pa'i gzhung zhabs ser skya che 'bring chung gsum/ dga' ldan khri gdan zur/ shar byang chodas rje/ gdan sa khag gi bla ma las sne/ sprul sku che chung / sa bkras gnyis kyi mi sna/ rgya gar/ rgya nag kha bal/a tsar+ya/ 'bras 'brug bcas kyi mi sna sogs gtos che bas mjal phyag zhus zhing / gzhung gnas nas dkar spro spom 'bul chodag zlos gar gyi rol rtsed sogs phebs ston dkar spro'i mdzad sgo legs par grub bstun yab gzhis sku ngo rnams 'phral sel bzhugs yul cadar gling pho brang gi nye 'gram las shag gzim chung du gdan zhus kyis sne bshan mkhan drung tā bla ma rong rnam sras thub bstan nor bzang (deng skabs 'dir yod chos don bka' blon zur pa de red ) rtsis dpon 'bri yul ba gnyis la bsko gzhag sngon grub 'dug par phebs ston dkar spro'i gse la bskang sogs rtsis 'bul legs par zhus pa bcas bod ljongs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i srog shing gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams

98cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchogag gi mchodag sprul yang srid rin lnga che rtsad dpyod gdan zhu spyor dngos mjug gsum mtha' dag gtso cher rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i byin stobs dang / rang gi tshe sngon bso/da nams kyi mthu la brten nas bya ba las kyi 'kho ra sku sku ga par ma 'phyan par legs byas kyi lam du song ba 'di dag ni skye ba don yod pa/ rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa/ bsam bzhin yid dga' ba dang bde ba bskyed pa'i dpyid du gyur ba'i skal ba rab kyi rtse mor son pa lags so//de rjes gru 'dzin pho brang chen po'i mi 'jigs seng ges btegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi che rgu mtha' dag gi gtsugak+ṣ-i rgyan nor bu'i do ker gyis lan gcig ma yin par btud pa la zhabs zung bkra shis kyi 'khor lo babo da de srid zhi yongs kyi 'dren pa chen por mnga' gsol ba dang / bod ljongs chab srid nyen 'gan ci che blo 'gan bzod bral gyang 'gyel dbyug slong thub dka'i mtshams su chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bdag gir bzhes pa/ gdan sa chen po rnam gsum dang / lha ldan smon lam chen mor mkhas mang 'dus pa khri ra brgal ba'i dbus

99su grwa bskor mtshan bzhes gnang ba/ bstan gshed rgya dmar gung phran tang gi bsam sbyor ngan 'khrul che bar dus bstun thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i bye brag so skye'i spyod yul las 'das pa ji snyed mchis pa sogs re re nas brjod langs bral ba dang / yab gzhis sku ngo rnams kyang 'khyongs thebs zur 'bul gyis bzhugs yul nor gling nye mtshams rgya mtsho dang / de rjes lcang gseb shar du gzims shag rgya che gsar bskrun la rim spo gnang ba'i skor sogs skabs so sor mdzad 'khur bzhes po zur du yod par brten rmongs rgan bdag 'dras gya tshom gyi yi ger 'bri 'god zhu rgyu skabs su babs min ltar bzhag cing / dngul brjes bya yul hu'u hu'u khang phu'u thon krang la chod gan nang gsal gyi dngul 'bab gang 'tshams lha sa rang nas gnang ba dang / de byings do bdag nas rgya gar du gnang dgos zhus par brten grwa bzhi slog 'khrul las khungs kyi las bya rim bzhi sum mdo ba rgyal mtshan yon tan khang phu'u thon kran dang mnyam du rgya gar la bka' brdzongs kyis gtsang sel gnang / sku 'bum dgon par gser bris kyi bka' bstan lam rkyang 'grub re bral rung / zhol dpar khang chen mor gsar

100'debs mdzad pa'i bka' 'gyur spus legs cha tshang dang / 7gong sa sku bo nga ma'i na bza' nyer chas/ dge 'dun dmangs la phyag tsha ma he rdo rje ma re sogs lcags 'brug lo zi ling sgar dpon dang / stag 'tsher sgar pa'i gnyer pa bsod nams nor bu can gyi gdong nges bskur mdzad/zi ling du mi gter lus pa rtse drung slo bzang tshe dbang la zi ling rmā kru'u zhis khyed rang rang bzhin sdod 'os ma che bas zi ling du bod kyi don byed khang gi ming 'khur bya dgos brjod 'dug par de skor phran rang nas thag gcod chodad min la ji 'gab rgyal khab tu snyan tar phul chog pa zhes zhus te don byed khang gsar 'dzub/sa mdzad tshe mi 'gro bslo brdzongs yong ba zhes lha ldan rgyal khab tu tar thog /nga tsho bod sar phebs chodad mtshams blo bzang tshe dbang lags bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gnas mjal la bskyodad 'thus zhes zhus te bskyod bsdad byas shing / de rjes khang phu'u thon krang la dngul brjes grangs tshang byung ba dang / mdo khams su srid ro/na rnyedag zing byung ba sogs kyis rkyen pas kru'u zhis bkag 'gog do snang che ba rang med gshis rta drel re

101zung 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i phebs bsu thon mi dang mnyam du sngon btang thog khong rang de rjes grwa rgyun gnas bskor bar brdzus te ḍa ru rkang gling 'khyer thodan bya rgyu yin lugs rgyal khab tu gsang tar 'byor 'phral nag chu nas rta khal gdong bsu ched stsal dang bcas kyis phyi lo 1940 bod rgyal lo 2067 lcags 'brug lo lha sar bde 'gyor thub pa red/rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang nas snyan tar phul 'byor ltar zi ling du don byed khang gsar 'dzugs gnang rtsis kyi mi 'gro rtse mgron lha bu rta ra thub bstan bstan dar dang / gyang grong rdo rje phun tshogs gnyis la bsko gzhag stsal zin 'dug kyang / de rjes rtse drung slo bzang tshe dbang bde bar thon bskyod zin pa dang / zi ling phyogs zhu sgo rgya che dmigs bsal med pa so/gas phan gce da dge skyon dathodangs bzhes kyis mi 'bosgo gtong gnang mdzad rgyu ngang 'then gnang ba lags/ngal dub r+yā gter brgal ba'i don mthun tshogs//rin chen gling nas mkho rgu'i nor gyi gter//re ba'i shing rta yid bzhin yongs bkang ste//

102lha ldan sprul pa'i gling der mngon par phyogs//phyogs kun dga' byed bkra shis ce ragye char//'bebs pa rdzogs ldan sprin gyi ngang tshul te//rdo rje'i snying por smin pa'i bsam 'phel mthus//babo da dka'i lam la tshegs med bde bar babo da//snying rje'i gter chen snang byed gzhon nu'i 'dzum//legs byas shar ris 'phos pa'i dril chen sgras//bsngags cadas srid zhi'i bla mar bkur dang lhan//'jigs bral gdong lnga'i khri 'phang dpal gyis brjid//

103le'u bdun pa/deb 'bri byed pa po'i lo rgyus dang /lhag bsam zhen gasku/la/byung tshul 'di dag 'bri ba po rang nyid lo rgyus zur tsam ma smos tshe ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs snurare gzigs snang la gzhung sa chen po'i zhi drag las tshan che chung theg pa rim 'dzegs kyi zhabs 'degs gang yang ma bsgrubs par skyid de ba las thod rgal du son pa'i mi rgan pra 'chal zhig gis nyams tshudang rgyus mnga' med pa'i lag dal gang byung 'bri bde byas 'dra'i dgongs tshul ji 'byung nges pa med par brten rags tsam 'bri bar bya zhing / de yang rmongs rgan 'kho ra ba pa bdag gang du skyes pa'i khyim zur khang zhes pa sngar chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud mnga' bdag 'od srung nas mched pa stod mnga' ris gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal brgyud sor mo/ dra bas 'brel ba'i ngo mtshar can zhig rgyal mchog bdun pa chen po'i skabs dbus su dre na par sa khang pha gzhis kyi bdag

104rkyen stsal te chos rgyal gyi gdung las zur du chad pa'i bla gdags kyi ming zur khang du grags shis/ der brten deng dus bar zur khang pa'i thob khungs ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi mnga' ris dang / gu ge khang tshan la byed bzhin thog mi rabs rim pas gzhung zhabs mu mthud zhu mur 7rgyal mchog dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mchod mdo khams ldan du sku bltams te gser khrir phebs skabs gzhung sa'i bka' 'brel ltar yab gzhis gsar 'dzugs ma dbotos par rgyal yum sras gsos bcas zur khang dang zla bsgril gyis zur sras tha'i ji tshe brtan rdo rje dang /7rgyal ba'i sku'i gcen mo thabs shes su 'brel ba'i rigs brgyud sras gnyis/ sras lnga/ gcig bcas byung yang / sras gnyis la brgyud pa ma byung bas gu ge'i gdung brgyud sprodags gshis sras mo'i steng du sger rnying rgyal rtse lcang lo can pa'i sras dbang chen nor bu go mag tu bsus 'dug cing / lcang lo can pa ni/ sngon dus rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i yang slob sngags rnying ma'i grub thodab rnyedab dawa na nam mkha' byang chub ces pa'i sras brgyud rim pas sa skya dang / phag grus bod dbang bsgyur skabs slon po'i go sa bzung mthar rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang

105 'phags dang / de'i sras rab brtan bkra shis 'phags sku gas kyi dus mnga' thang ches cher dar yang / sde pa gtsang pas dbus gtsang dpung gshed kyis bzung skabs mnga' thang phal cher shor nas rgyal rtse lcang lo can pa zhes sger pa chung ngu zhig tu lhung zhing / 7rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i skabs nas bzung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i drung 'khor gyi gras su zhugs te sde dpon che khag tu gzengs bstod dang 'brel gtsang ljongs kyi mda' dpon sogs rim par byung ba'i rigs brgyud mes po dbang chen nor bu zur khang gi go mag tu phebs te dbus mda' dpon mdzad cing / de'i sras zur khang zhabs pad bsod nams dbang chen dang / gzhung zhabs mi rabs rim brgyud sger pa rnying khung gtsang rong khul rnar skyid gshongs pa'i bu mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma gnyis la rigs myug sha stag lnga byung ba'i tha chung du sngon bsags bsod nams kyi mthu las dal 'byor gyi rten bzang thob pa yin zhing / bu gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa gnyis chung ngu'i dus nas 'das/ bu dang po bsam grub tshe brtan nam rjes sor ming sgyur dbang chen tshe brtan 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku dus rtsam len nas bzung las tshan

106theg pa rim 'dzegs kyis sku srung mda' dpon bar dang / de nas bar skabs shig la las rkyen dbang gis mda' dpon las 'khur phyir 'then mdzad thog zur khang nas zur rbon gnang dgos byung rung / de rjes mdo smad gzhung 'bru do dam dang / dmag sgar ja dang po'i mda' tshab/ mda' dpon cad ma/ dza sag gi mtshan gnas 1sgog mdo khams zhi drag spyi 'doms/ tho/da gzhung phyi rgyal las khungs kyi snga dam pa bcas rim par gnang ba da lta'i zur khang zhabs pad dbang chen dge legs sogs kyi skyed byed dza sag zur khang zur pa zer ba rgya dmar bod du slebs rjes gshegs pa de dang / bu gsum pa pad+ma dbang chen chung ngu'i dus nas bya spyod gang ci gzhan mtshungs bral zhing / chos srid kyi mkhyen rlabs dang / yig rtsis yon tan rtser son sprodag /rgya nag gi skad yig kyang shes pa sku gas gang sa nas snyan grags can la brten dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog zhabs zhus rjes phebs byam 'go pa bsko gzhag stsal te 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen sngo lcags khyi 'o/ rgya mo ga yul gru nas phyir phebs skabs phebs bsu dang /de rjes chu byi rgya dmag zing 'khrugs mjug rgya gar nas phyir phebs

107skabs kyang zhabs zhus kyis 7gong sa chen ngo ston 'khor yar 'brog bsam sdings su bzhugs 'jags skabs bka' drung bsko gzhag sung5 'brel lha ldan rgyal khab chen por zhabs sor 'khod rjes bka' shag gi yig rigs gang ci sde tshan dbye 'byed dkar chag phyogs bsgrig mdzad rgyus mtshon 'khur babs zhu sgo gang cir zhus rjes ngo gzengs thodan pa byung ba na chosad gzhon babs kyis zhabs pad lnga ma bsko gzhag stsal bder ma gyur rkyen bka' drung che ba rim bzhi zhes sngar srol la med pa'i go ming dang 'brel bka' shag sbug tu gdan 'phar gsar sgron gyis dbang tshad zhabs pad dang 'dra mnyam 'char gzhi yig khag la legs bcetes mchan bu gnang 'os rigs zhabs pad ngo ma min gshis 'bri snag rgya skyegs ma yin par snag tshas gnang rgyu bcas dmigs bsal gzigs bskyangs che mdzad/ de bzhin phyi lo 1916thodad rgyal lo 2043 me 'byug lo dgung lo 22 thog gshegs pa red/ nged rang thog mar rab byung gi brtul zhugs bzung rgyu'i re 'char gyis dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa kā ri kā lnga bcu par grags pa blo 'dzin so/gas byas khul yang / las skal bsod nams dman

108rkyen kun bzang rtse'am khe smad pa'i zhabs pad rin chen dbang rgyal gyi sras mo rgan pa bde skyid dbyangs can gyi mag par 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi gnyen sbrel dgos lugs zhabs pad tsha phro nga pa zla bzang dgra 'dul brgyud gsung nan che zhing / zur khang du khyim 'dzin gcen po sku 'gres gtan zhal sras gsos bcas yod mus kyang / skabs der gcen po pad+ma dbang chen gshegs pa'i lcam kher bur brten nang nye khag dang / gasku ga rigs rgan gras 'ga' shas skusags bsam gros re thesgogs sna tshogs shig byung chodad sogs rkyen mang sne 'doms 'di skor gzhi rkang rang gi sngon bcadas las mtha' zad pa gzhir bcas kyang / 'phral rkyen ni 'khor ba'i chos nyid phyi nang gnyis ka'i mdzad phyogs thabs 'phrul sna chodags dbang gis mabo skra yang lan tshar gsog khosgom med par mgo hril thog kun bzang rtse'i go mag tu slebs shing /phyi lo 1919 lnga da rgyal lo 2046 sa lug lo rang lo 19 thog 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen por mjal phyag dang 'brel gnam bskos gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang pa chen wa'i drung 'khor lha yi spun zla lta bu bgrang ba las 'das pa'i gras su zhugs/ lo

109der bka' shag shodad pa dang / lcags bya lo bka' shag mabo na gnyer/shing glang lo kong po rtse sgang rdzong sdod bcas rim par bsko gzhag stsal te rtse sgyu nga las 'khur skabs phyi lo 1927 phra da rgyal lo 2054me yos 'o/ spo bo ka gnam sde 'bangs gzhung sar ngo 'o/ga gis lha spyi dmag sgar ta dang po'i mda' dpon stag sna ba rkyen lam du btang rkyen skadang sngo khul yul dmag bsdu bskul gyis spo wa mas skadang lnga phyogs babo da lam khag bkag bsdoms srung 'asnga mas dbo sa rgyu'i bka' rgya phebs thodan srung 'doms le thogs med pa zhu mur sa 'brug 'o/ kha dang gra bzhi rgya sbyongs dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon zas zhim pa'i tshab nged rang la bsko gzhag dang 'brel ru khag gnyis kyi dmag mi kong por bka' brdzongs gnang don spo khongs rong stong rgyugs rdzong sa len zhus pa'i thodag byed gte gtso wa ka gnam bkras po sogs spo nang nas lho khug ces par bros byol gyis sbreng zam khag bcad 'then byas lugs mdo spyi'i bka' rgya phebs 'byor byung don lto khug gi rgyab ri pad+ma bkod chung phyogs khel bar brten dmag mi hrag 100 'khrid de skadang smad rgya la dang / de nas rta khal thar yul lta ci mo nga sa bzha' rlan dbang

110gis khyodan lham yang 'char can gyis mkho phan bral bas rkyal pa rnying pas lham gzugs gsar bzos la thur 'gro lam ji bzhin med pa'i gzar zug che sar g.yas g.yon smyug gsar rnams la 'tham 'khyud dang /brag g.yang nyen 'gan che sar zhag thag ring po btang ste bzung bskyod sogs ngal ba dwang len gyis pad+ma bkod chung brgyud bskyod skabs ka gnam bkras ngo ngo g.yog rnams nas rjes 'ded 'byedar ba shes tsho ra gyis chu brgyud nas rgya gar go+o ha tra phyogs snga sa 〈snal gyis rjes 'o/na ma thub par phyir log bya dgos byung ba bcas phar phyin nyin nyi shu skor 'bo ra/ phyi lo 1929 lnga da rgyal 'oge 2056 sa sprul 'o/ rgyal khab nas khams tshudags sa mtshams nyen 'gan che gshis 'bo( dmag rnams kong po nas thad kar khams bskyod dgos rgyu zhes phebs dodan kong wa zho kha brag gsum gyen la brgyud khams thon gyis dang thodag ri bo che dang /de rjes go 'jo gser kha gnyis kyi sa srung dang / sde dge sa khral spyi khyab bcas rim zhus thodag phyi 'osgo 1931 wa da rgyal 'o/ 2058lcags lug 'o/ bka' 'brel nyag mo nga sa blangs kyis sa cad 'go dmag mabo 'bul zhus pa mi rgyu khrasnag gsum la mnar spyod gzan god phra mo

111tsam med par mdo khams zhi drag spyi khyab par chab mdor rtsis 'bul zhus pa rjes su khyung ram nas rgya ngo da chings mo la skabs dar dbo na spyi bso sa 'du chos mdzad stag lha sku gas rgya mis dar mdor bce na bzung byas pa dang mi brjes nyo da len gnang bde sku gas spyi cadas gang sar don phan dge mtshan chen sngo byung sdudang zhing / de rjes nyag srung kha dang gnyis pa'i ru dpon 'go dmag rang 'jags kyi dpung cadan du hor khog nas dmag sgar nya dang mda' dpon bde smon 'go dmag gtong rgyur nged rang sde dger phyir bskyod dgos rgyu phebs pa bzhin sde dger sdod skabs lha ra khog zhi chings mdzad sngo khyung ram pa nas gya snu ma rtab brel gyis bre bor gye ngan la dpung 'jug 'thab 'dzings kyis be ru sras mkhar rdzong bar sa shor dang / des rkyen nyag rong dang / dar rgyas dgon pa/ sde dge sogs rim pas mang sne nyung bsten ma thub par sa shor rgya che byung rkyen mda' dpon khyung ram pa dang / bde smon pa/nged rang bcas gsum ka rim pas las 'khur phyir 'then mdzad don nged rang chu spre zla 9 nang lha sar 'byor/ chu bya dbyar thog dbyin gzhung nas spus bzhes me mdel 'don 'dren du gro mor gtong gnang

112mdzad pa dbyin mda' kha thung 5000 mdel bcas dang / me sgyogs kyi mde'u rnam grangs bcas shing khyi dbyar thog bod ljongs domag spyi mkhan drung bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / sku srung mda' dpan snang dkar sras gnyis la rtsis 'bul zhus rjes codal gnyer balha gzhag stsal zhing / shing phag lo zhor skyong lha ldan jo bo chen wa'i bzhugs khang ghak+to la dang / thugs rgyan gsar bas sogs sngags khang bzo grwa'i do dam/phyi 'e 1936 bod rgyal lo 2063 me byi 'o/ mtshan zhabs ke'u tshang rin po che dang lhan du zi ling khul spyi nor yang srid rin po che rtsad dpyod zhu bcar sa yos lo phyir 'khor gyis dbyin gzhung 'bras spyi'i sne bshan/ lcags 'brug 'o/ shun khul 'bras spungs sngags pa grwa tshang gi chodas gzhis khag la 'byed khra gsar 'bo da/ phyi lo 1941 11da rgyal lo 2068 lcags sgrul lo 7gong sa 7skyabasta mgon sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog chu rta rab bzhes bka' drin che skabs rtse shod sogs rten mdzadag rnams la na bza' mchod rdzas 'grems 'bul gnang rgyu'i bzo grwa'i do dam bcas zhus shing / chu lug lo ja tsha do dam du 'phos pa dang / phyo lo 1945 bod rgyal

112dilo 2yi72 shing bya lo a mi ka dang dbyin ji/ rgya nag bcas par sku bcar dza sag rong dpal lhan thub bstan bsam 'phel dang mnyam sbrel gyis g.yul rgyal legs 'bul sku tshab tu gtong sa/nang me phag lo phyir 'khor/ phyi lo 1948 bod rgyal 'i 2075 sa byi bod ljongs dmag spyi bsko gzhag stsal 'brel yul dus gnas skabs dang mthun pa'i dmag khrims don tshan so lnga gsar baX dang / dmag rtsed kyi skad brda/ gus 'dud che chung bi/ dung tshig sogs bod skad bzo sgyur zhus/ phyi sku 1950 ngo da rgyal lo 2077 lcags stag lo 7gong sa 7skya bas mthodan chen wa'i chibs zhabs kho ngas gro mor sku da pa nas mkhan drung thub bstan bstan dar dang mnyam du zhabs pad nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi phyag rogs su rgya nag tu gtong gnang gis rgya bod gros mthun bsnol 'jog phyi 'i 1953 bod rgyal lo 2080 chu sprul lo 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po shing rta thugs d+nghardzogs bka' drin che rgyu'i mchod rdzas bzo grwa'i do dam/ me sprelalja lo 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen thod rgya gar nang pa'i chos tshogs su gdan zhus ltar chibs sgyur bka' drin che ba'i chibs zhabs khongs so/gas

114 dzizhi drag las tshan che chung rim zhus yun sku nga la brten me bya 'o/ dmag spyi'i las 'khur dbo ngas pa zhus 'kho la gyis ༷ ra yangs lhod sdod byed mur spyi lo 1959 bod rgyal 'o/ 2086 sa phag lo bod rang btsan sger langs mi mang snu gas pas tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi 'dems bskos kyi khongs su tshud/ bod zla 2 tshes 10 mtshan mo phyed yol cu tsho da 3 thodag rgya dmar nas me 'phen 'bo 'dzugs kyis tshes 11/12 sku sku ra me sgyogs kyi drag char tshan cher phab ste tshang ma chags thabs bral gshis tshes 13 dpo ngas dro nged rang dang tshe dbang don 'grub de nyid/ rogs zla skal bzang nor bu bcas rang gi bu phrug sogs 'dod gcig mi ngo rgan gazlo na bcu gsum gyis mtshon snon bcud yongs rdzogs shul du bzhag ste 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i phebs rjes lon res bye'u rdo thos/ nas 'phur ba ji bzhin nyang bran brgyud jog po ri khrod dang / de nas dge 'phel ri'i rgyab brgyud ra tshag ram pa mda' sgro gzhis sogs ri la ri brgyud nyin mo mi 'grul che skabs yib bsdad mtshan mo rkang babo da kyis skyid nag ko sar tshes 19 bar ma slebs shing / de nyin ko ba sgug dzā da skabs 7gong sa

1157skyabs mgon chen po'i chibs rjes blta bskyod yin tshod gnam gru phyur mdog zhig thon bskyod kyis chu tshod phyed bzhi tsam nas phyir 'kho ra byung sku nga ba ko sar phran tsho 'grul mi gang 'tshams 'dzoms 'bungs rnams gnam gru'i skad sgra snga phyir go 'phral kha gram yib bsdad rjes lcags gzam gyu bstodar gyis de nub lcags gzam dgon du lhod nyal bya rgyu byung / tshes 20 nyin chu sgang gi dos skyel gong dkar smon bo nga gi bong brjes phyir log la 'phros mol gyis bong bur bzhon rgyu byung ba sdug po skyid wa'i mdog 'don zhes dpe don mtshungs nges rnam kun rta bzang sga gdan gyis spras te ba'on pa las/ de nyin bong bu'i khal sga'i steng bde 'jam skyid pa'i ngang nas gong dkar du 'byor zhing /de nas gra phyi nang brgyud 'phyongs rgyas phu zur rtsa dang / sga 'dra/ so khad/ sman thang / lho brag sras mkhar klong mawa sogs brgyud mon la dkar chung brgyab ste 'brug khongs mtshams pa sa gnas su 'byor/nyin re bzhin btsan byol rim 'byor la me 'phen sogs tshul min rtsing spyod dkrogs rkyen dang / nang khul 'then 'khyer med pa bya gal che lugs dngos brgyud zhib mol dang / 'brug pa'i sa srung dasngo na rigs

116che chung la thabs shes 'phros mo/la bya rgyu sogs rang nus gang thon zhu mur bdun phrag gnyis skor song mtshams 'byug pa'i srid slon ngo phebs byung bstun thon snga phyi sogs 'a'o/sa mo la brgyan rgyag dang 'brel wa da tshes 22 nyin mtshams pa sa gnas nas the ga lnga na dbang 'dus chos gling nas phreng ring lha lcam rin chen sgrol ma lags dang bcas 'brug gzhung brgyud de rgya 'brug sa mtshams rdzas sgang dang / de nas mo tor ri li brgyud ka lon sbug tu bod zla 4 tshes 30 nyin 'byedar zhing / de nas bzhugs sgar gyi bka' gsal dang bstun spyi zla 8 tshes 25 nyin ma su rir gangs can lha gcig 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor gzi 'od 'bar bzhin par dasngo sa mjal skal bzang dga' ston la 'o/ngas su spyodad skabs bstan gshed rgya mi dmar pos khungs med btsan gce na dbang gis dpon 'bangs tshang ma 'dzin dbang snod bcud yongs bral gzhan sar 'khyar 'khyams yul dus ngan pa'i snang tshul dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdzad 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mthu dpal nyid las srid zhi'i 'dren mchog 7gong sa yid bzhin nor bu bstan 'gro'i mgon

117dpung dam par rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du zhabs sor legs 'kho da thub pa'i dga' ba mnyam 'gran bsam brjod kyi yul las 'bo ngas pa de sngon zi ling du dang thog spyi nor yang srid rin po che rnyed pa'i dus skabs dang gnyis su med pa lta bu zhig byung zhing / de mtshams ka sbug don gcod balha gzhag stsal 'brel slar yang sa gnas su phyir bskyod las 'khur zhus/ phyi 'e1 1960 cadad rgyal lo 2087 lcags byi lo bzhugs sgar rda ram sa la'i zhabs zhur bcar dgos phebs pa ltar phyi zla da tshes 1 nyin 'byor ba dang / zla 9 nang slad kyi mdzad phyogs lha ra las khungs khag lnga gsar 'dzugs gnang khongs shes rig gtso 'dzin gyi lī sa gro gas dang / sger gsal las 'gan shes rig zlos gar tshogs pa'i 'go 'dzin gyis chodas rgyal khri sku nga sde'u btsan rgyal rabs dang / mdo smad chol kha'i gtam brjod sogs khrab ston srol 'byed/ de rjes nang srid bka' slon las rogs dang / rtsom sgyur lhan tshogs kyi las rogs bcas par rim 'phos thog zur du dze smad rin po che sogs dang lhan rgyas slob deb 'dzin grwa bcu gcig bar bskyar bsgrigs sogs snga rjes khyon sgril mi lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun ring

118 zhabs zhus la zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba'i chod spo sa dang / nus stobs gang ci nam mkha'i pablo'i mched zlar gyur gshis chos srid lugs gnyis gang thad nas ngo so sgon pa 'di zhus kyis byas rjes bgrang rgyu ma mchis mo da/ pha65 bu rabs nas gzhung sa'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i mnga' 'bangs/ 'phral yunatsalegs tsho gas thams cad dga' ldan pho brang pa'i thugs rje kho nar brten nas byung ba yin gshis gzhung dodan la rgya'i sgo ra la bya bzhag gang cir lho nus kyis ji cadabs lhag bsam rnam dag zol med zhus pa 'di tsam legs byas kyi snying por brlom khul lags shing / da cha bgrang bya'i phreng ba re drug tu son par ma zad/ dbang lnga nyams rgud kyis zhabs 'degs ji bzhin rngo thog dka' bar brten phyo 'o/ 19snyo5 wa da rgyal 'o/ 2092 shing sbul 'o/ rgas yol zor yangs dal sdod chog pa zhes 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por gasku la 'debs snyan zhus ltar dgostongs 'kho la gzigs bskyangs bka' drin che thob kyis smyod dal du gnas mur/ skabs re'i yid kye 'char sgor deng skabs 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i brtse chen byams pa'i thugs rjes byes 'byor bod phrug na gzhon stong phrag mang
